The role involves close coordination with Production, Packing, Dispatch, Kitchen Stewarding, Maintenance, HR, Training, Procurement, and Receiving departments to ensure adherence to food safety, GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices), and GHP (Good Hygiene Practices). The QA Manager will also be responsible for the creation and implementation of the Food Safety Management System (FSMS) manual, including development of Critical Control Points (CCPs), SOPs, and quality audit frameworks and conduct periodic audits.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Quality Assurance \& Food Safety**

* Develop, implement, and maintain **FSMS Manual** in compliance with FSSAI, HACCP, ISO, and other statutory requirements.
* Establish and monitor **Critical Control Points (CCPs)** across production, packing, dispatch, and receiving operations.
* Ensure **GMP \& GHP standards** are implemented and followed across the factory and stores.
* Conduct routine quality checks of raw materials, in\-process products, and finished goods.

**2\. Audits \& Compliance**

* Plan and conduct **internal audits** for central kitchen and COCO stores.
* Coordinate **third\-party and regulatory audits** (FSSAI, HACCP, ISO, customer audits).
* Maintain all necessary documentation, traceability records, and compliance reports.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) in case of deviations.

**3\. Cross\-functional Coordination**

* Work closely with Production, Packing, Dispatch, Stewarding, and Maintenance teams to address quality and hygiene issues.
* Partner with HR \& Training to develop and deliver **food safety \& hygiene training programs** for all staff.
* Coordinate with Procurement \& Receiving for vendor audits, raw material quality checks, and specifications compliance.

**4\. SOPs \& Process Control**

* Draft, implement, and periodically review **SOPs for all operational areas** – production, handling, packaging, storage, dispatch, and outlet\-level practices.
* Monitor adherence to SOPs through inspections and feedback loops.
* Develop guidelines for pest control, sanitation, and cleaning protocols.

**5\. Continuous Improvement \& Reporting**

* Analyze quality trends, customer complaints, and wastage data to drive continuous improvement.
* Provide monthly reports on quality KPIs, audit findings, compliance status, and training effectiveness.
* Support management in decision\-making with data\-driven insights.

**Desired Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of **FSMS, HACCP, FSSAI, ISO 22000, GMP \& GHP**.
* Experience in quality assurance for bakery, patisserie, FMCG, or large\-scale food production units.
* Excellent documentation, audit, and compliance management skills.
* Strong leadership, training, and cross\-functional collaboration abilities.
* Analytical mindset with problem\-solving orientation.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s/master’s in food technology**, Food Science, Microbiology, or related field**.
* **8–12 years of QA experience** in food manufacturing/central kitchen, with at least **3–5 years in a managerial role**.
* Hands\-on experience in implementing HACCP/ISO systems and handling food safety audits.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Audit compliance scores (internal \& external).
* FSMS implementation effectiveness across units.
* CCP adherence and deviation closure rate.
* Number and quality of trainings conducted.
* Reduction in customer complaints and non\-conformities.
* Vendor compliance and raw material quality score.

**Job Summary**

The **Payroll \& Benefits Specialist** will be responsible for supporting accurate and timely payroll processing and benefits administration for employees in India. This role ensures compliance with applicable statutory requirements, internal policies, and payroll governance standards while delivering high\-quality employee experience. The position partners closely with HR, Finance, external vendors, and employees to manage payroll inputs, benefits operations, reporting, reconciliations, and issue resolution.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Benefits Administration**

* Support communication of benefits offerings, policies, and employee enrollment processes.

* Assist in benefits billing validation, reconciliations, and reporting.
* Support annual benefits renewal activities and periodic program reviews.

**Compliance and Controls**

* Ensure payroll \& benefits processes comply with applicable laws, regulations, \& internal company policies
* Support statutory compliance activities related to payroll, including filings, deductions, and reporting.
* Assist with internal \& external audits by preparing documentation and responding to information requests.
* Identify process risks, control gaps, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee data and handle sensitive information with a high degree of integrity.

**Reporting and Process Improvement**

* Prepare regular and ad hoc payroll and benefits reports for HR, Finance, and management stakeholders.
* Analyze payroll and benefits data to identify trends, discrepancies, and improvement opportunities.
* Support system testing, process documentation, and implementation of payroll or benefits changes.
* Contribute to standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives across payroll and benefits operations.

**Qualifications**

* BBA in Human Resources from a reputed institute
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in payroll and benefits administration, preferably in a multinational or complex organization
* Experience managing payroll operations and employee benefits in India.

* Strong understanding of payroll processes, controls, and employee data management.
* Knowledge of India payroll statutory requirements and benefits practices.
* Experience supporting audits, reconciliations, and compliance reporting.
* Exposure to process improvement, standardization, or HR operations transformation initiatives.

**Key Skills, Competencies \& Behaviours**

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* High level of confidentiality and professional judgment, and acts with integrity.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Customer\-focused and continuous improvement mindset with a commitment to service excellence.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
* Drives accuracy, discipline, and accountability in execution.
* Collaborates effectively across teams and functions.
* Delivers a positive employee experience through responsive support.

We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be – and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to:


* *Grow* : Be part of our global company with 20\+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.

* *Belong* : Experience an awesome place to work where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for diversity, equity, and inclusion.

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the \#1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us!


***We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too.***

Joining the Stanley Black \& Decker team means working in an innovative, tech\-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black \+ Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights.

For resumes and LinkedIn profiles, the title should be tailored to the specific industry and role, often incorporating key skills or certifications such as B.Tech Computer Science Graduate or Certified Digital Marketing Fresher. Using the exact job title from the job description (e.g., Marketing Associate – Fresher) can improve visibility in applicant tracking systems (ATS) and align the candidate’s profile with recruiter expectations.

**First Response Executive (FRE) – Lead Response \& Qualification**

**Célèbre Aesthetics**

Become the First Voice a Lead Experiences

At Célèbre Aesthetics, the first response to an enquiry can shape the entire patient journey that follows.

We are looking for a warm, confident, highly responsive and dependable First Response Executive (FRE) who can respond to new enquiries promptly, understand the lead’s requirement, ask the right initial questions and ensure that every genuine enquiry is handled professionally.

This is not simply a calling position. It is a first\-response and lead\-qualification role for someone who understands that speed, communication, accurate information and consistent follow\-up are essential to creating a strong first impression.

About Célèbre Aesthetics

Célèbre Aesthetics is a premium, specialised aesthetic surgery centre with a growing presence across Gujarat.

We offer planned aesthetic procedures including:

· Hair transplant

· Chest\-shaping surgery

· Nose reshaping

· Breast enlargement, reduction, lifting and shaping

· Fat\-removal and body\-contouring procedures

· Tummy shaping

· Intimate aesthetic procedures

· Other advanced aesthetic treatments performed by experienced plastic surgeons

Célèbre is a planned aesthetic healthcare environment rather than an emergency hospital. Our focus is to combine professional healthcare standards with a premium, comfortable and personalised patient experience.

About the Role

The First Response Executive will be the first point of contact for incoming leads and enquiries. The role is responsible for responding quickly, understanding the basic requirement of the lead, conducting the initial qualification and ensuring a smooth handover to the appropriate team.

The person in this role must be comfortable with a high\-response environment where new enquiries need to be addressed without unnecessary delay.

· Respond promptly to new leads and incoming enquiries.

· Return missed calls and messages at the earliest possible opportunity.

· Prioritise new enquiries and maintain timely initial and follow\-up communication.

· Understand the lead’s basic concern and requirement.

· Ask relevant qualification and screening questions during the call.

· Record accurate lead information and ensure proper handover to the concerned team.

· Coordinate with Medical Sales Counsellors, Patient Coordinators and other relevant teams.

· Maintain professional, warm and reassuring communication throughout the interaction.

Key Responsibilities1\. First Response to New Leads

· Respond to new leads quickly and professionally.

· Ensure no genuine enquiry is unnecessarily left unanswered.

· Return missed calls and messages at the earliest possible opportunity.

· Maintain a fast, prompt and consistent response to new leads.

2\. Lead Qualification \& Initial Screening

· Understand the reason for the enquiry.

· Ask relevant initial questions to understand the lead better.

· Capture basic details required for further coordination.

· Identify the lead’s requirement and readiness for further discussion.

· Ask questions clearly and naturally rather than making the conversation sound mechanical.

3\. Gynecomastia Lead Screening

· Understand the patient’s concern.

· Ask how long the concern has been present.

· Ask whether the patient has previously consulted a doctor or taken any treatment.

· Ask the area where the patient lives.

· Ask the patient’s age and occupation/work.

· Ask whether the patient does heavy lifting, gym or strenuous physical activity.

· Understand whether the patient is looking specifically for a surgical solution or wants to explore options.

· Ask about the patient’s expected consultation timeline.

· Check whether the patient is comfortable visiting Célèbre Aesthetics, Gota.

4\. Lead Handover \& Coordination

· Share relevant lead information accurately with the concerned team member.

· Coordinate with Medical Sales Counsellors and other concerned teams for the next step.

· Ensure that important information gathered during the first call is not lost during handover.

· Follow up internally when required so that the lead receives the appropriate next response.

5\. Follow\-Up

· Maintain timely follow\-up with leads as required.

· Respond to replies and callbacks promptly.

· Keep track of pending responses and follow\-ups.

· Do not allow leads to remain unattended because of delayed communication.

6\. Communication \& Information Handling

· Provide only approved and accurate information.

· Do not diagnose, make medical conclusions or promise treatment outcomes.

· Escalate medical or clinical questions to the appropriate authorised team member.

· Maintain professionalism and confidentiality while communicating with leads.

The Three Qualities We Value Most

**Character**  
Treat every lead, patient, family member and colleague with dignity, patience and respect. Maintain professionalism even when the interaction is challenging.

**Integrity**  
Communicate truthfully, share accurate information, protect confidentiality and never hide an important communication gap or mistake.

**Ownership**  
Do not simply pass a lead to somebody else. Understand what needs to happen, coordinate the appropriate person, follow up and ensure the lead reaches the right next step.

Who Will Succeed in This Role

· Very fast and responsive in replying to new leads and messages.

· Naturally warm, pleasant and confident on calls.

· Has a clear, professional and reassuring voice.

· Communicates comfortably in English, Hindi and Gujarati.

· Listens carefully and asks relevant questions.

· Can qualify leads without making the conversation feel like an interrogation.

· Is comfortable making calls and receiving incoming enquiries.

· Has strong follow\-up discipline.

· Can handle multiple leads and priorities simultaneously.

· Is organised and accurate while recording lead information.

· Takes ownership rather than waiting for repeated instructions.

· Remains calm and respectful with different types of callers.

· Is comfortable working in a target\- and response\-driven environment.

· Is professionally groomed and presentable.

· Learns quickly and accepts feedback positively.

Essential Requirements

· Graduate or diploma holder from a recognised institution.

· Fluent spoken English, Hindi and Gujarati.

· Ability to read and write professional English.

· Excellent telephone etiquette and verbal communication.

· Professional grooming and confident communication.

· Warm, pleasant and reassuring demeanour.

· Basic computer knowledge.

· Comfortable maintaining lead records and follow\-up information.

· Comfortable working full\-time and on\-site at Gota, Ahmedabad.

· Willingness to work Monday to Saturday.

· Relevant experience in lead handling, calling, customer service or healthcare is preferred.

Preferred Background

· Tele\-calling / lead generation

· Customer service

· Healthcare or clinic front office

· Patient coordination

· Hospitality

· Guest relations

· Aviation / cabin crew

· Premium customer service

· Sales support or inside sales

Previous experience is a plus, but speed of response, communication, maturity, ownership, listening ability and lead\-handling skills will matter strongly in the selection process.

Why Join Célèbre?

**Work in a Premium Aesthetic Healthcare Environment**  
Gain experience in a specialised aesthetic healthcare environment with a strong focus on patient experience.

**Build Lead\-Handling Expertise**  
Develop practical skills in first response, qualification, communication, follow\-up and internal coordination.

**Learn the Aesthetic Healthcare Journey**  
Understand how an enquiry moves from the first response towards counselling, consultation and further patient coordination.

**Responsibility, Not Just Calling**  
The role requires ownership of the quality and speed of the first response, not merely completing calls.

**Long\-Term Career Growth**  
A capable performer may grow into senior lead\-handling, counselling, patient coordination or centre\-coordination responsibilities. Growth will depend on capability, character, ownership, judgement and results.

Working Details

This is **not a training\-only position**. The selected candidate will be expected to learn quickly, research independently, build working solutions, and take ownership of AI/ML projects.

The candidate will work on **Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, AI APIs, automation, data processing, computer vision, NLP, predictive systems, and AI\-powered business applications**.

The ideal candidate may be a fresher, but should demonstrate the ability to **build real projects independently and figure out unfamiliar technologies when required**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. AI/ML Application Development**

* Develop AI and machine learning solutions for real\-world business requirements.
* Build AI\-powered web and software applications.
* Integrate AI functionality into existing company products.
* Develop prototypes and convert successful prototypes into production applications.
* Research and implement appropriate AI/ML approaches for new requirements.

**2\. Generative AI \& LLM Development**

Work with technologies such as:

* OpenAI APIs
* Gemini APIs
* Claude APIs
* Open\-source LLMs
* Hugging Face
* LangChain / LlamaIndex
* RAG systems
* Vector databases
* Embeddings
* AI agents
* Prompt engineering
* Function/tool calling

Responsibilities may include:

* Building AI chatbots.
* Developing AI assistants.
* Creating RAG\-based applications.
* Connecting LLMs to company databases and applications.
* Building AI agents and automation workflows.
* Developing document/question\-answering systems.
* Creating AI\-powered business tools.
* Evaluating and improving AI responses.

**3\. Machine Learning**

Work with:

* Supervised learning
* Unsupervised learning
* Classification
* Regression
* Clustering
* Recommendation systems
* Forecasting
* Anomaly detection
* Model evaluation
* Feature engineering

The candidate should be able to select appropriate ML approaches based on the problem rather than simply following tutorials.

**4\. Python Development**

Strong working knowledge of Python is expected.

Work with libraries/frameworks such as:

* Python
* NumPy
* Pandas
* Scikit\-learn
* PyTorch
* TensorFlow
* FastAPI
* Jupyter

The candidate should be capable of writing production\-oriented Python code, not just notebook\-based experiments.

**5\. Data Processing**

* Collect and clean datasets.
* Perform data preprocessing.
* Handle missing and inconsistent data.
* Perform exploratory data analysis.
* Prepare datasets for ML models.
* Build data processing pipelines.
* Analyze model results and identify improvements.

**6\. NLP**

Work on applications involving:

* Text classification
* Sentiment analysis
* Document processing
* Text extraction
* Summarization
* Question answering
* Search
* Chatbots
* Document intelligence

**7\. Computer Vision**

Where required, work with:

* Image classification
* Object detection
* OCR
* Image processing
* Document scanning
* Face/object recognition
* Video analysis

Experience with OpenCV, YOLO, PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar technologies is an advantage.

**8\. AI API \& Software Integration**

Integrate AI capabilities into:

* Websites
* Mobile applications
* Web applications
* Business software
* POS systems
* CRM/ERP systems
* Internal company tools
* SaaS products

Build APIs using technologies such as:

* FastAPI
* Flask
* Node.js
* REST APIs

**9\. AI Agents \& Automation**

Research and build intelligent automation systems capable of:

* Calling external APIs.
* Processing documents.
* Retrieving information.
* Executing predefined actions.
* Connecting multiple software systems.
* Automating repetitive business workflows.
* Using tools/function calling where appropriate.

**10\. Model Deployment**

Learn and implement:

* Model serving
* API deployment
* Docker
* Cloud deployment
* GPU environments
* Model optimization
* Monitoring
* Version management

Exposure to AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or equivalent platforms is an advantage.

**11\. Research \& Problem Solving**

This is a critical part of the role.

The candidate should be able to:

* Research unfamiliar technologies independently.
* Read technical documentation.
* Study GitHub repositories and implementation examples.
* Understand new AI models and frameworks.
* Experiment with multiple approaches.
* Identify why a solution is failing.
* Find and implement a practical solution.
* Learn new technologies quickly without requiring step\-by\-step training.

**The candidate should be a self\-learner.**

Full\-Stack AI Development

The candidate may also be required to connect AI systems with web applications.

Knowledge of:

* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript
* React / Next.js
* Node.js
* APIs
* Databases
* Git/GitHub

will be a strong advantage.

The ideal candidate can build:

**Frontend → Backend → Database → AI Model/API → Deployment**

as a complete working product.

**Required Technical SkillsMandatory**

* Strong Python fundamentals.
* Strong programming and logical problem\-solving skills.
* Understanding of Machine Learning fundamentals.
* Understanding of AI/LLM concepts.
* Experience with at least one real AI/ML project.
* Ability to work with APIs.
* Basic database knowledge.
* Git/GitHub knowledge.
* Ability to read technical documentation.
* Ability to independently research solutions.

**Strong Advantage**

* OpenAI API
* Gemini API
* Claude API
* Hugging Face
* LangChain
* LlamaIndex
* RAG
* Vector databases
* PyTorch
* TensorFlow
* Scikit\-learn
* Pandas
* NumPy
* OpenCV
* YOLO
* FastAPI
* Docker
* AWS / Azure / Google Cloud
* React / Next.js
* PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB

**Qualifications**

* B.E / B.Tech – Computer Science / AI \& ML / Data Science / IT
* BCA / MCA
* B.Sc Computer Science / Data Science / AI
* Other relevant technical qualifications

Freshers are welcome.

Experience Requirement

**Formal work experience is not mandatory.**

However, the candidate should demonstrate **experience\-level practical capability** through:

* Personal AI/ML projects
* College projects
* GitHub repositories
* Internships
* Freelance projects
* Research projects
* AI applications
* Machine learning models
* AI automation projects
* LLM/RAG applications

**Important: Practical Ability Over Qualification**

We are specifically looking for candidates who can **build things**, not candidates who only know AI/ML theory.

A candidate who can independently build a working AI application will be strongly preferred over a candidate with excellent academic marks but limited practical experience.

Problem\-Solving Expectations

The candidate should be comfortable receiving a requirement such as:

**"We need an AI system that can read uploaded documents, understand the information, answer questions, and integrate with our web application."**

The candidate should be able to:

* Understand the requirement.
* Research suitable technologies.
* Design the solution.
* Build a prototype.
* Test the approach.
* Fix problems.
* Integrate it with the application.
* Deploy it.
* Improve it based on feedback.

They should **not require someone to explain every technical step**.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Ability to independently solve problems.
* Number and quality of working AI/ML projects.
* Development speed.
* Quality of implementation.
* Ability to research and learn new technologies.
* Model/application accuracy and performance.
* Successful API and software integrations.
* Bug fixing and troubleshooting ability.
* Code quality and documentation.
* Ability to convert requirements into working solutions.
* Innovation and experimentation.
* Project ownership.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is:

**A fresher by experience, but an experienced thinker.**

We are looking for someone who:

* Loves technology.
* Builds projects independently.
* Is curious about AI.
* Learns extremely fast.
* Can research without constant supervision.
* Can solve unfamiliar technical problems.
* Is comfortable experimenting.
* Can work under deadlines.
* Takes ownership.
* Is not afraid of difficult technical requirements.
* Can move from an idea to a working prototype.
* Wants to become a strong AI/ML engineer.

Most Important QualityWe are not looking for someone who knows everything. We are looking for someone who knows how to find, learn, build and solve anything.Career Growth

**AI/ML Engineer – Fresher**  
↓  
**AI/ML Engineer**  
↓  
**Senior AI/ML Engineer**  
↓  
**AI/ML Technical Lead**  
↓  
**AI Product / Engineering Lead**

**Position Summary**

**Designation:** AI/ML Engineer – Fresher  
**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 Year  
**Department:** Artificial Intelligence / Software Development  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu  
**Primary Focus:** AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, Automation, APIs, Data \& AI\-powered Software

**Meg World Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a high\-potential fresher who can grow into an independent AI/ML engineer capable of researching, developing, integrating, deploying, and maintaining AI\-powered products.**

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: AI Product Developer Intern
description:
**Company:** Tattvalogic  
**Role:** AI Developer Intern  
**Experience:** Freshers / Students / 0–1 Year  
**Employment Type:** Internship  
**Location:** Bangalore / Remote  
**Department:** Product \& Engineering

About Fritado

Fritado is an AI\-powered growth automation platform designed to help businesses discover prospects, identify the right buyers, engage them through personalized outreach, and automate their sales and marketing workflows.

Fritado combines **Artificial Intelligence, Lead Generation, Sales Automation, Data Intelligence, Email Outreach, Workflow Automation, and AI\-powered insights** into a single platform.

We are looking for enthusiastic and curious **AI Developer Interns** who want to work on a real\-world AI SaaS product and gain practical experience building intelligent features that are used by businesses.

About the Role

As an **AI Developer Intern**, you will work closely with our product and engineering teams to build, test, improve, and deploy AI\-powered capabilities within Fritado.

This is a hands\-on role where you will have the opportunity to work with **Generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, AI agents, APIs, data processing, automation workflows, and AI\-based decision systems**.

You will not simply be working on training exercises or sample projects. You will contribute to actual product features and engineering initiatives within Fritado.

Key ResponsibilitiesAI \& Generative AI

* Work with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI APIs.
* Develop and optimize prompts for different product use cases.
* Build AI\-powered content generation and personalization features.
* Experiment with different AI models and evaluate their performance.
* Develop structured prompts and AI workflows for reliable outputs.
* Implement AI\-based classification, extraction, summarization, and recommendation capabilities.
* Help improve the accuracy, relevance, and consistency of AI\-generated responses.

AI Automation \& Agents

* Assist in developing AI agents and autonomous workflows.
* Work on AI\-driven lead research and prospect intelligence.
* Help build AI systems that analyze companies, contacts, industries, and buyer profiles.
* Contribute to automated decision\-making and qualification workflows.
* Build integrations between AI services and Fritado's backend systems.
* Work on AI\-powered sales and marketing automation.

Product Engineering

* Develop and integrate AI features into the Fritado platform.
* Work with REST APIs and backend services.
* Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code.
* Debug and troubleshoot AI and application\-related issues.
* Test AI features against different inputs and edge cases.
* Collaborate with developers, product managers, and other interns.
* Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.

Data \& Intelligence

* Work with structured and unstructured data.
* Assist with data cleaning, transformation, extraction, and enrichment.
* Build logic for analyzing prospect and company information.
* Help improve AI\-based lead qualification and scoring.
* Work with databases and APIs to support AI\-powered product functionality.

Required SkillsMust Have

* Basic programming knowledge in **Python or JavaScript/Node.js**.
* Understanding of APIs and JSON.
* Basic understanding of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning concepts.
* Interest in Generative AI and Large Language Models.
* Understanding of prompt engineering concepts.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to learn new technologies quickly.
* Good debugging and troubleshooting skills.

Good to Have

* Experience with OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, or other LLM APIs.
* Experience with Python AI/ML libraries.
* Knowledge of LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar AI frameworks.
* Basic knowledge of MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or other databases.
* Experience building REST APIs.
* Knowledge of Node.js, Express, React, or Next.js.
* Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
* Experience with vector databases or RAG.
* Understanding of embeddings and semantic search.
* Previous AI/ML or Generative AI projects.

What You Will Learn

During the internship, you will get practical exposure to:

* Generative AI and LLM application development
* Prompt engineering
* AI agents and autonomous workflows
* AI\-powered SaaS product development
* API integration
* AI evaluation and quality control
* Data processing and enrichment
* Lead intelligence and sales automation
* Backend and product engineering
* Database integration
* Git/GitHub and software development practices
* Production\-level debugging and deployment

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is ideal for:

* B.Tech / B.E. students
* M.Tech students
* MCA students
* Computer Science / IT students
* AI/ML students
* Recent graduates
* Self\-taught developers with strong AI interest

Candidates with **personal AI projects, GitHub repositories, hackathon projects, or college projects involving AI/ML or Generative AI** are encouraged to apply.

We value **ability and curiosity over certificates**.

What We Look For

We are looking for candidates who:

* Are genuinely interested in AI.
* Enjoy building and experimenting.
* Can solve problems independently.
* Are comfortable learning unfamiliar technologies.
* Can understand an existing codebase.
* Pay attention to quality and details.
* Are willing to take ownership of assigned tasks.
* Can work in a fast\-moving product environment.
* Want to build technology that solves real business problems.

Internship Experience

You will work on real Fritado product initiatives rather than isolated academic assignments.

Depending on your skills and performance, you may get opportunities to contribute to areas such as:

**AI Lead Intelligence → AI Research → Lead Qualification → AI Outreach → Workflow Automation → AI Agents → Sales Intelligence → Generative AI**

High\-performing interns may be considered for a **full\-time AI Developer / AI Engineer opportunity** based on business requirements and performance.

Selection Process

The selection process may include:

* Resume / Application Review
* Technical Screening
* AI / Programming Assignment
* Technical Interview
* Final Discussion

Candidates may be asked to demonstrate an existing AI project or build a small AI\-powered application as part of the evaluation.

Why Join Fritado?

* Work on a real AI SaaS product.
* Get hands\-on experience with Generative AI.
* Work closely with an experienced product/engineering team.
* Build features that can reach real users.
* Gain exposure to AI agents and automation.
* Develop production\-level engineering skills.
* Opportunity for full\-time employment based on performance.

**If you are excited about AI and want to move beyond tutorials into building real AI products, we would love to hear from you.**

Pay: From ₹10,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

title: Tellecaller
description:
**About the Role**

Meg World Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a **confident, professional and customer\-friendly Telecaller / Customer Support \& Business Enquiry Executive** to handle incoming and outgoing calls for the company's different business divisions.

The candidate will communicate with customers, leads, clients and enquiries related to:

* **Real Estate**
* **Software \& Web Development**
* **Websites**
* **Digital Services**
* **Training / Education**
* **Business Services**
* **Other company products and services**

The primary responsibility is to **answer enquiries professionally, understand customer requirements, provide accurate basic information, collect lead details, follow up with prospects, and transfer qualified enquiries to the appropriate team.**

**Key Responsibilities**  
**1\. Incoming Calls \& Enquiries**

* Answer incoming customer calls professionally.
* Understand the reason for the enquiry.
* Identify the customer's requirement.
* Provide basic and accurate information about company services.
* Collect customer name, phone number, requirement, location and other relevant details.
* Forward qualified leads to the concerned department.
* Ensure no genuine enquiry is ignored or lost.

**2\. Real Estate Enquiries**

Handle calls related to:

* Residential properties
* Apartments
* Villas
* Plots / Land
* Commercial properties
* Property sales
* Property rentals
* Property investment enquiries

**Responsibilities include:**

* Understand the customer's budget.
* Identify preferred location.
* Understand property requirements.
* Record lead information.
* Arrange follow\-ups.
* Coordinate with the real estate sales team.
* Schedule site visits when required.
* Follow up with interested customers.

**The telecaller is not expected to provide technical/legal advice about properties unless specifically authorized.**

**3\. Software \& IT Enquiries**

Handle enquiries related to:

* Website development
* Web applications
* Mobile applications
* POS software
* CRM / ERP
* Custom software
* E\-commerce
* WordPress websites
* AI/ML solutions
* Digital services
* Software maintenance

**Responsibilities include:**

* Understand what the customer wants.
* Ask basic requirement questions.
* Collect project details.
* Identify whether the enquiry is for a website, software, app or other service.
* Record the lead.
* Schedule a consultation/demo with the technical or sales team.
* Follow up with potential customers.

The telecaller **does not need to be a technical developer**, but should learn the company's products and services sufficiently to explain them at a basic level.

**4\. Lead Generation \& Outbound Calls**

* Make outbound calls to prospective customers.
* Contact leads generated through:
* Website
* Social media
* Advertisements
* WhatsApp
* Online enquiries
* Events
* Existing customer referrals
* Company databases where legally permitted
* Introduce the company and relevant services.
* Understand customer requirements.
* Generate interest.
* Schedule meetings, demos, consultations or site visits.

**5\. Follow\-Up**

* Follow up with leads regularly.
* Maintain proper follow\-up records.
* Contact customers according to the assigned follow\-up schedule.
* Remind customers about meetings, demos, site visits or consultations.
* Identify interested, pending and inactive leads.
* Escalate important or high\-value enquiries to management.

**6\. Customer Support**

* Handle basic customer questions.
* Assist existing customers with general enquiries.
* Understand complaints and concerns.
* Record customer issues accurately.
* Forward technical issues to the technical team.
* Follow up until the issue is properly assigned or resolved.
* Maintain professional communication with customers.

**7\. WhatsApp \& Digital Enquiries**

Where required, handle customer communication through:

* WhatsApp
* Email
* Website enquiries
* Social media messages
* Online enquiry forms

Maintain professional communication and ensure customer enquiries receive timely responses.

**8\. Lead Management / CRM**

* Enter every qualified enquiry into the company's CRM or lead management system.
* Maintain accurate customer information.
* Update lead status.
* Record call outcomes.
* Schedule follow\-up dates.
* Maintain notes regarding customer requirements.
* Avoid duplicate or incomplete lead entries.

**9\. Coordination**

Coordinate between:

**Customer → Telecaller → Sales / Real Estate Team / Software Team / Management**

The candidate should ensure that the customer's requirement reaches the correct person.

Required SkillsMandatory

* Good communication skills.
* Pleasant and confident telephone manner.
* Ability to speak clearly.
* Basic computer knowledge.
* Basic knowledge of WhatsApp, email and internet.
* Ability to understand customer requirements.
* Good listening skills.
* Ability to maintain records.
* Willingness to learn company products and services.
* Professional and polite behaviour.

Preferred

* Tamil communication skills.
* Good English communication skills.
* Hindi or other languages will be an advantage.
* Previous telecalling experience.
* Sales/customer support experience.
* Real estate experience.
* IT/software sales experience.
* CRM experience.

Language Requirements

**Tamil:** Preferred / Strong advantage  
**English:** Basic to good communication required

Candidates who can communicate confidently with customers in both **Tamil and English** will be preferred.

**Educational Qualification**

* 12th Pass
* Diploma
* Any Bachelor's Degree

Freshers are welcome.

Good communication and customer\-handling ability will be given more importance than academic qualifications.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

* Confident
* Friendly
* Patient
* Professional
* Good at listening
* Comfortable speaking on the phone
* Positive and energetic
* Responsible
* Target\-oriented
* Willing to learn
* Able to handle different types of customers

The candidate should not be afraid of making calls or speaking with new people.

Performance Expectations

The candidate will be evaluated based on:

* Number of calls handled.
* Quality of customer communication.
* Lead information accuracy.
* Follow\-up discipline.
* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Meetings/demos/site visits scheduled.
* Customer satisfaction.
* Response time.
* CRM/lead management accuracy.
* Conversion support.
* Professional behaviour.

**Quality of calls and qualified leads are more important than simply making a high number of calls.**

Daily Responsibilities

A typical day may include:

**Morning**

* Check new enquiries.
* Review pending follow\-ups.
* Prioritize important leads.

**During the Day**

* Answer incoming calls.
* Make outbound calls.
* Follow up with previous enquiries.
* Update CRM.
* Coordinate meetings/site visits/demos.
* Respond to WhatsApp enquiries.

**End of Day**

* Update all lead statuses.
* Record call outcomes.
* Prepare pending follow\-up list.
* Report important enquiries to the concerned team/management.

Career Growth

**Telecaller / Customer Support Executive**  
↓  
**Senior Customer Support Executive**  
↓  
**Business Development Executive**  
↓  
**Sales / Business Development Manager**  
↓  
**Business Development Lead**

High\-performing employees may be given opportunities to move into sales and business development roles.

Important Responsibilities

The employee must:

* Never intentionally ignore a customer enquiry.
* Never provide false information to customers.
* Never make unauthorized promises regarding price, delivery, property availability, software features or timelines.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer information.
* Follow company communication standards.
* Escalate important complaints and high\-value enquiries to management.
* Maintain accurate lead records.

Position Summary

**Designation:** Telecaller / Customer Support \& Business Enquiry Executive  
**Experience:** Fresher / 0–2 Years  
**Department:** Customer Support / Business Development  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Primary Responsibilities:**  
**Inbound Calls \+ Outbound Calls \+ Customer Support \+ Lead Generation \+ Follow\-Up \+ Real Estate Enquiries \+ Software Enquiries \+ Website Enquiries \+ CRM/Lead Management**

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

JOB DESCRIPTION — COMMIS CHEFStarbrews Coffee Shop

**Location:** TCI Chowk, Rourkela, Odisha  
**Department:** Kitchen  
**Reports To:** Head Chef / Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About Starbrews

Starbrews Coffee Shop is a modern café focused on **fresh brews, cozy vibes \& quick bites**, serving quality coffee, snacks, continental food and bakery products. We are building a professional café operation with strong focus on **consistency, hygiene, speed and customer experience**.

Position Overview

We are looking for a **Commis Chef** to support the Head Chef in the day\-to\-day kitchen operations. The candidate will be responsible for **food preparation, cooking assistance, mise en place, hygiene, portion control and maintaining kitchen standards**.

The ideal candidate should be hardworking, disciplined, quick to learn and comfortable working in a fast\-paced café environment.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Food Preparation**

* Assist the Head Chef in preparing continental dishes, snacks, sandwiches, burgers, pasta, fries and other café items.
* Complete daily **mise en place** before service.
* Wash, cut, portion and prepare ingredients as per SOPs.
* Follow standardized recipes and portion sizes.
* Ensure food is prepared fresh and consistently.

**2\. Kitchen Operations**

* Assist the Head Chef during peak service hours.
* Ensure orders are prepared within the required service time.
* Maintain an organized and efficient workstation.
* Coordinate with the barista and service team for smooth order flow.
* Inform the Head Chef/Manager immediately about any shortage of ingredients or kitchen issues.

**3\. Hygiene \& Food Safety**

* Maintain high standards of personal and kitchen hygiene.
* Follow proper cleaning and sanitization procedures.
* Prevent cross\-contamination during food preparation.
* Ensure raw and cooked food are stored separately.
* Follow **FIFO (First In, First Out)** principles.
* Check food quality, freshness and expiry dates.

**4\. Inventory \& Wastage**

* Handle ingredients carefully and minimize wastage.
* Inform the Head Chef about low\-stock or damaged items.
* Follow correct storage procedures.
* Help with daily stock checking when required.
* Ensure ingredients are properly labelled and stored.

**5\. Closing Duties**

* Clean and sanitize the workstation after service.
* Properly store leftover ingredients.
* Clean kitchen equipment and utensils.
* Ensure gas, electrical equipment and kitchen appliances are safely switched off as per closing SOP.
* Leave the kitchen ready for the next day's operations.

Skills Required

* Basic knowledge of cooking and food preparation.
* Understanding of kitchen hygiene and food safety.
* Ability to follow recipes and SOPs accurately.
* Good knife\-handling and preparation skills.
* Ability to work quickly during busy hours.
* Team player with good communication skills.
* Willingness to learn new recipes and café operations.
* Punctual, disciplined and responsible.

Experience

**Preferred:** 1–2 years of experience in a café, restaurant, hotel or QSR kitchen.

**Freshers:** Candidates with basic cooking knowledge and a strong willingness to learn may also be considered.

Working Conditions

* Full\-time café kitchen role.
* Flexible working hours depending on café operations.
* Must be comfortable working during weekends and holidays.
* Work involves standing for extended periods and working in a busy kitchen environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Commis Chef will be evaluated on:

* **Food quality \& consistency**
* **Preparation speed**
* **Hygiene and cleanliness**
* **Recipe \& portion adherence**
* **Food wastage control**
* **Mise en place readiness**
* **Team coordination**
* **Punctuality \& discipline**
* **Following kitchen SOPs**

Salary

**₹12,000–₹16,000 per month**, depending on experience and skill level.

Career Growth

A successful Commis Chef can progress to:

**Commis Chef → Demi Chef de Partie → Chef de Partie → Senior Chef / Kitchen Supervisor**

What We Expect From You

At Starbrews, the Commis Chef is not just a cooking assistant. You are expected to **take ownership of your station, maintain cleanliness, follow recipes, work with urgency and continuously improve your skills.**

**“Good food starts with a disciplined kitchen.”**

Education

company: Air India SATS Airport Services Private Limited (AISATS)
description:
**Location: Trivandrum** 




  





**ABOUT AIR INDIA SATS AIRPORT SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED** 




 AISATS, a leading gateway services provider in India, is a 50\-50 joint venture between Air India Limited (a part of the TATA Group) and SATS Ltd., one of the world’s largest providers of air cargo handling services and Asia’s leading airline caterer. ‘AISATS’ is defined by its people – they are our greatest strength. Their commitment to seamless delivery and customer delight is what enables us to fulfil our brand promise of service excellence. This has been the hallmark of our business for more than a decade. With deep domain knowledge of the aviation ecosystem, we offer end\-to\-end ground handling services such as passenger and baggage handling, ramp handling, aircraft interior cleaning, load control and flight operations, and cargo handling services for general, perishable, transshipment, express courier and special cargo.
 



  





**MANAGER\-INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS** 




  





  





 JOB PURPOSE \& SPECIFICRESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





**INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS \& EMPLOYEE RELATIONS** 



* Develop and maintain cordial, harmonious, and constructive industrial relations within the organization.
* Act as the primary interface between Management, employees, and recognized unions on matters concerning industrial relations.
* Engage with Union Office Bearers and Committee Members on issues affecting employees and organizational operations.
* Address employee grievances, concerns, and workplace issues through timely and effective resolution mechanisms.
* Provide guidance and support to line managers on employee relations and industrial relations matters.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, regulations, company policies, and standing orders.



  





**LABOUR LITIGATION \& STATUTORY REPRESENTATION**



* Draft and review replies to Statements of Claim, complaints, notices, and other submissions before labour authorities.
* Represent the Company in conciliation proceedings before Labour Commissioners, Labour Officers, and other statutory authorities.
* Handle labour and employment\-related cases before Labour Courts, Industrial Tribunals, Industrial Relations Authorities, and other judicial forums.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel and labour law consultants on ongoing litigation and advisory matters.
* Prepare case briefs, factual summaries, and supporting documentation for legal proceedings.
* Attend hearings before various Courts, Tribunals, and quasi\-judicial authorities as required.



  





**DISCIPLINARY MANAGEMENT**



* Manage disciplinary proceedings in accordance with principles of natural justice and applicable laws.
* Draft show\-cause notices, charge sheets, suspension orders, warning letters, and other disciplinary documents.
* Conduct or coordinate domestic inquiries and disciplinary investigations.
* Ensure proper documentation and record maintenance of all disciplinary matters.
* Provide recommendations to Management on disciplinary actions based on investigation findings and inquiry reports.



  





**STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT \& REPORTING**



* Liaise and coordinate with government authorities, labour departments, legal advisors, and external agencies on employee and industrial relations matters.
* Maintain accurate records of ongoing industrial disputes, legal cases, settlements, and disciplinary proceedings.
* Prepare and submit periodic MIS reports and management updates on IR matters, labour litigation, conciliations, and employee relations issues.
* Analyze industrial relations trends and recommend proactive measures to mitigate risks and enhance employee engagement.



  





**OPERATIONAL, SAFETY \& COMPLIANCE RESPONSIBILITIES**



* Ensure adherence to Company policies, labour laws, and statutory compliance requirements.
* Promote and uphold Quality, Safety, Security, and Operational Excellence standards across all areas of responsibility.
* Support organizational initiatives aimed at employee welfare, workforce stability, and operational efficiency.



  





**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Graduate with PG Diploma in Personnel Management and IR / Degree in Law / MSW/ Post Graduate degree in Business Management (PGDBM) with specialization in HUMAN RESOURCE MANAGEMENT.



  





**RELEVANT EXPERIENCE** 



* Minimum 5 years of experience in Human Resources and Industrial Relations functions.
* Proven experience in handling employee relations, union interactions, collective bargaining, and labour law compliance.
* Experience in representing organizations before Labour Authorities, Labour Courts, Industrial Tribunals, and other statutory forums.
* Exposure to disciplinary proceedings, domestic inquiries, and labour litigation management.
* Experience in service industries, aviation, logistics, manufacturing, or other labour\-intensive sectors will be preferred.



  





**PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS \& BEHAVIOURS** 



* Integrity, honesty, and strong ethical values.
* Leadership mindset with a collaborative approach.
* People\-centric with a strong sense of empathy.
* Open\-minded, mature, and balanced in decision\-making.
* Strong relationship\-building and influencing skills.
* Long\-term strategic perspective.
* Ability to manage diverse workforce groups and group dynamics.
* High resilience and adaptability in a dynamic work environment.

 Job Title
   

  

 Manager \- Human Resources
   

  

**Job Description**
 The HR Manager will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end Human Resources operations for the plant, including talent acquisition, employee relations, industrial relations, payroll inputs, statutory compliance, employee lifecycle management, performance management, contract labour administration. The role will partner closely with business leaders, employees, unions, contractors, and external authorities to ensure compliance, operational excellence, and a positive employee experience while supporting organizational objectives.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Employee Relations \& Industrial Relations**
* Build and maintain positive employee relations across the plant.
* Address employee grievances and ensure timely resolution.
* Foster healthy relationships with unions and employee representatives to maintain industrial harmony.
* Support disciplinary processes, grievance redressal, and employee engagement initiatives.


**Statutory Compliance \& Labour Law Management**
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory regulations, and company policies.
* Manage compliance related to PF, ESIC, PT, Bonus, CLRA, Factories Act, and other applicable labour legislations.
* Prepare and submit statutory returns, reports, and documentation within prescribed timelines.
* Support internal and external audits and ensure compliance closure.


**Contract Labour \& Vendor Compliance**
* Manage contract labour administration and compliance monitoring.
* Verify vendor compliance documents and statutory records.
* Ensure adherence to statutory and company compliance requirements for contractors and service providers.


**Payroll \& HR Operations**
* Ensure accurate and timely payroll inputs, including attendance, leave records, incentives, and deductions.
* Support payroll processing and Full \& Final Settlement (F\&F) activities.
* Manage employee confirmations, transfers, promotions, separations, and exit formalities.
* Conduct exit interviews and derive actionable insights.


**Performance Management**
* Drive Performance Management System (PMS) processes across the plant.
* Support goal setting, performance reviews, appraisal cycles, and performance discussions.
* Partner with functional leaders to drive a performance\-oriented culture.


**Other Responsibilities**
 Support Talent Acquisition and any other responsibilities assigned by the HOD or Management.
   

  

**EXPERIENCE** 
 (No of Years): 6 \- 10 years in HR
   

  

**QUALIFICATION:** 
 Master’s degree in Human Resources / Employee Relations
   

  

**Skills And Competencies**
* Strong knowledge of Employee Relations (ER), Industrial Relations (IR), and labour law compliances.
* Ability to build positive employee and union relationships while maintaining industrial harmony.
* Strong grievance handling, conflict resolution, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Effective communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Process\-oriented approach with strong attention to detail and documentation management.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Basic Formulas, and HR MIS reporting).

**Release Assurance at the Speed of AI \|** 
**Meet the new Sauce Labs**
 The Role
   

  

 We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented HR Ops Manager to drive operational excellence and manage core employee lifecycle processes in our India office. In this role, you will be responsible for end\-to\-end Onboarding and Off\-boarding, leading the Internal Committee for PoSH compliance, ensuring Indian statutory compliance, and supporting HRBP activities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Onboarding \& Offboarding Lifecycle
* Onboarding: Own the entire new\-hire experience from offer acceptance to day 30/60/90 integration \- ensuring document verification, background checks (BGV), system access, and orientation.
* Offboarding: Manage seamless exit processes, including resignation handling, exit interviews, asset clearance coordination, full \& final (F\&F) settlement coordination, and exit analytics.
* Continuously refine onboarding and offboarding workflows to improve candidate experience and operational efficiency.
* PoSH Committee Management \& Employee Relations
* Serve as the primary lead/Presiding Officer/member for the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (PoSH) Internal Committee (IC).
* Ensure 100% compliance with the Indian PoSH Act, including organizing mandatory awareness sessions, annual filing, and managing IC meetings.
* Handle sensitive employee relations issues, grievances, and formal investigations with complete discretion, empathy, and adherence to legal protocols.
* Support and advise local middle managers on employee relations, performance issues, and team dynamics.
* HR Operations \& Indian Statutory Compliance
* Oversee HR operational processes for India, ensuring compliance with local labor laws, Shop \& Establishment Act, PF, ESIC, LWF, and Gratuity.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR systems, and audit\-ready compliance documentation.
* Partner with Finance/Payroll teams to ensure accurate inputs for monthly payroll processing and exit settlements.


**Required Skills**
* Experience: 5 \- 8 years of progressive HR experience, with a solid mix of HR Operations and statutory compliance.
* PoSH Expertise: Proven experience leading or actively participating in a PoSH Internal Committee (IC) and managing formal workplace investigations.
* Employee Lifecycle: Strong hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end Onboarding, Offboarding, and HR operations in India.
* Tech\-Savvy: Experience working with modern HRIS, performance tools (e.g., Lattice, BambooHR, Workday), and grievance platforms.
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with high emotional intelligence and discretion.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Formal certification as a PoSH Enabler / IC Member.
* Experience working in global, distributed, or fast\-paced technology/startup environments.

title: Deputy Manager - MIS
description:
Job Description
**JOB DESCRIPTION**


**MIS****– International Business \& Global Reporting**


**Function**  

Finance \& Accounts  

  

**Reports to**  

CFO – Garment Business  

  

**Location**  

Mysore Road, Bangalore  

  

**Team managed**  

Individual contributor  

  

**Employment type**  

Full\-time
  

**Role purpose**


Responsible for consolidating, validating, and standardizing data across international factories and buyer programs into a single, reliable reporting layer. The role sits between factory\-level MIS submissions and the FP\&A / leadership reporting cadence, ensuring that order, cost, and production data flowing in from multiple overseas factories is accurate, timely, and presented in a consistent format for decision\-making.


This is a build\-phase, execution\-focused role: the person will help set up recurring MIS templates and reporting cadences from scratch, working closely with the FP\&A Lead/Analyst, Merchandising, and factory\-level teams, in a multi\-factory (CMT/FOB) international manufacturing environment.


**Key responsibilities**


**MIS and data consolidation**


* Collect, consolidate, and validate MIS submissions from multiple international factories (production, order status, cost, and shipment data).
* Maintain standardized MIS templates and ensure factories report on a consistent format and cadence.
* Reconcile factory\-level data against central records maintained by the Virtual Manufacturing Office and flag discrepancies for follow\-up.
* Build and maintain trackers for order\-wise, factory\-wise, and buyer\-wise status across the international business.
**Global and management reporting**


* Prepare recurring dashboards and reports (weekly/monthly) covering order pipeline, capacity utilization, and factory performance for the FP\&A Lead and Head of Department.
* Support the FP\&A team with data inputs for budget vs. actual and variance reporting.
* Assist in preparing management presentations and business review decks with accurate, up\-to\-date data.
* Track key international business metrics (lead times, on\-time shipment, order fulfilment) and highlight exceptions.
**Coordination and follow\-up**


* Liaise with factory\-based teams to chase pending data and close reporting gaps.
* Coordinate with Merchandising, Quality, and Compliance teams to ensure MIS reflects the latest order and compliance status.
* Support the Logistics Extension Executive and Export \& Trade Compliance Executive with shipment and documentation data as needed for reporting.
**Systems and process**


* Work within the ERP/costing/MIS tools to extract, clean, and organize data for reporting.
* Support continuous improvement of reporting templates, automation of recurring reports, and reduction of manual data\-chasing.
* Maintain a clean, well\-documented data trail for audit and review purposes.
**Candidate profile**


**Experience**


* Fresher or 1–2 years of experience; prior exposure to MIS, reporting, or business analyst roles is a plus but not mandatory.
**S****kills**


* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, lookups, dashboards); working knowledge of PowerPoint for reporting decks.
* Comfortable working with large, fragmented datasets from multiple sources and consolidating them accurately.
* High attention to detail and ownership of data accuracy and timeliness.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to coordinate with factory teams and internal stakeholders across functions.
* Proactive follow\-up skills – comfortable chasing data from multiple factories/teams to meet reporting deadlines.
**Qual****ification**


* MBA (Finance)

title: Associate - Founder's Office
description:
**THE ROLE IN ONE LINE** 




 You get dropped into a team that has a number which is not moving. You use AI to move it. Six weeks. Then you rotate to the next one.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 



* Embed with one function for six weeks: sales operations, marketing measurement, cost and efficiency, or delivery. One named sponsor, one signed outcome.
* Spend week one watching the real work. Sit on demo calls. Sit beside an Account Director for a full call block. Pull the data yourself. You will not diagnose a business from a dashboard.
* Build the thing that fixes it. An agent, a workflow, a scoring model, an automation that removes fifteen hours a week. You build it, not a vendor and not the engineering team.
* Get it adopted. Sit next to the people using it until they use it without you in the room.
* Hand it over with a named owner and a runbook, then write a one\-page memo carrying a rupee number that your sponsor and Finance both sign.
* Rotate. Roughly six of these a year.



  





**WHAT YOU WILL HAVE DONE BY YEAR ONE** 



* Day 30: one automation live that removes 10 or more hours a week of manual work.
* Day 90: two functions worked, ₹40 lakh of annualised, counter\-signed impact.
* Month 12: six projects shipped, verified impact of at least six times your cost, and function heads asking for you by name.



  





**WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 



* An engineering degree from a Tier 1 institute, 0 to 2 years out.
* Ex\-product, ex\-consulting, or someone who has run an AI\-led initiative end to end. Any of the three works.
* Something you have shipped with AI that another person used repeatedly. Not drafts and summaries. A workflow, an agent, a scoring model, an internal tool. Send the link; we will ask you to walk us through the decisions you made building it.
* SQL and spreadsheets at working fluency. You get your own data. You do not raise a ticket to answer a question.
* Clear, short writing. The one\-page memo is the actual product of this job.
* Comfort with being the most junior person in the room, telling a function head that their process is the problem, and being welcome there afterwards.



  





**DO NOT APPLY IF** 



* Your AI experience is prompting a chatbot for drafts and summaries.
* You need a fully specified brief before you can start.
* You want to work on strategy without pulling data or shipping anything.
* You cannot name a specific number you moved and explain how it was measured.



  





***HOW TO APPLY***




 Send a link to something you have built, along with your CV. Applications without a link will not be reviewed.

description:
**Role:** 
 Business Analyst \& Fundraising Associate — Founder's Office
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, Maharashtra (on\-site; some travel)
 



**Employment:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 1–4 years
 



  





**About Doto Health (Care Mother)** 




  





 Doto Health Private Limited, operating as CareMother, is a Pune\-based, Made\-in\-India femtech and medical\-device company on a mission to create equal opportunities of care for women. We build a full\-stack, AI\-enabled maternal\-care platform — spanning conception to post\-partum — that combines smart monitoring devices, AI\-powered decision support and protocol\-driven workflows for fetal, labour, birthing and post\-partum care.
 



 Our flagship products include AnandiMaa (antenatal care platform), FetoMax (wireless NST/CTG fetal monitor) and Nurtura (intrapartum and post\-partum AI co\-pilot). CareMother is already deployed across 28 states and 2,500\+ facilities in India and seven LMICs, covering 700,000\+ pregnancies and 2 million\+ tests, and is a licensed CDSCO medical device backed by clinical research partnerships with IIT Bombay, the University of Oxford and Mayo Clinic.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 The Founder's Office is the engine room of the company — where strategy, data and execution meet. As Business Analyst \& Fundraising Associate, you will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the Founder \& CEO to turn ambiguous problems into structured analysis, decisions and outcomes. Roughly half of your time will be spent on business analysis and strategy, and half on driving our fundraising — an active Pre\-Series A equity round alongside impact and grant funding. It is a rare front\-row seat to how a mission\-driven healthtech company scales, and a launchpad for a career in strategy, investing or entrepreneurship.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Business Analysis Strategies:** 



* Build and maintain financial models — revenue projections, unit economics, pricing, burn and runway — and pressure\-test key business assumptions.
* Run market and competitive research — TAM/SAM/SOM sizing, competitor landscapes, regulatory and clinical scans — and distil it into clear, decision\-ready insights.
* Prepare board decks, strategy memos and business cases that translate data into a crisp narrative for the CEO, board and partners.
* Track KPIs and build dashboards across installations, patient volumes, revenue and product metrics to surface trends and risks early.
* Own special projects across GTM, partnerships, pricing and new\-product initiatives — scoping, analysing and driving them to closure.



  





**Fundraising \& Investor Relations:** 



* Support the Pre\-Series A raise end\-to\-end — refine the pitch deck, teaser, one\-pagers and financial model in partnership with the CEO.
* Build and manage the investor pipeline — research VCs, impact investors, family offices and strategics, and maintain a disciplined outreach tracker/CRM.
* Set up and run the data room and coordinate due\-diligence requests, keeping documents accurate, organised and audit\-ready.
* Research and draft grant applications for philanthropic and impact funding (e.g. BIRAC, Grand Challenges, global health foundations) and track milestones and reporting.



  





**Who You Are** 



* 1–4 years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, VC/PE, a startup founder's office/chief\-of\-staff role, or strategy/BizOps.
* Strong financial modelling and Excel skills, and excellent PowerPoint/deck\-building — you can turn a blank page into a board\-ready story.
* Sharp analytical and research ability with structured, first\-principles problem\-solving and strong attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — able to write a tight memo and brief a CEO with equal ease.
* High ownership and comfort with ambiguity; you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and follow through without being asked twice.
* A Bachelor's degree in engineering, finance, economics or business; an MBA or CFA progress is a plus.



  





**Bonus Points** 



* Exposure to healthcare, healthtech, medtech or femtech, or to impact/social enterprise and LMIC health markets.
* Prior involvement in a fundraise or grant application (equity or philanthropic).
* Data fluency with SQL, Python or BI tools (Power BI / Tableau / Looker).



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct mentorship from the Founder \& CEO and a front\-row seat to strategy, fundraising and board\-level decision\-making.
* Real ownership and steep growth — visible impact from day one and a clear path into strategy, investing or leadership roles.
* Mission that matters — your work helps make pregnancy and childbirth safer for mothers and newborns across India and LMICs.
* Competitive compensation and a collaborative, high\-calibre team at our Pune headquarters.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send your CV and a short note on why this role excites you to prachi@dotohealth.com with the subject line
 *“Founder's Office — Business Analyst \& Fundraising Associate”* 
 . Sharing a work sample — a model, deck or analysis you're proud of — will strengthen your application.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Company Overview
   

 Jetbro is a technology partner for enterprises where reliability is non\-negotiable. We build and integrate mission\-critical systems across technology consulting, engineering, data, cloud, and AI. Our operating principle is Function over flash. Always. We favour practical, resilient engineering and solutions designed for long\-term clarity, scale, and business impact.
   

  

 The selected candidate will be employed by Safal Softcom (Jetbro's Partner company) and work on\-site from Safal Softcom’s premises, embedded within its product team. SAFAL is an AI\-powered Source\-to\-Pay platform for industrial enterprises, supporting complex, high\-volume, business\-critical procurement operations across areas including sourcing, supplier management, contracts, purchasing, invoicing, and spend intelligence.
   

 About the Role
   

 We are seeking an AI Engineer with 1–3 years of experience to join a 20\-person B2B product team. In this full\-time, on\-site role, you will help develop and productionise intelligent features for enterprise procurement workflows. Your work will support practical use cases including supplier scoring, spend analytics, forecasting, recommendations, document intelligence, anomaly detection, and workflow automation.
   

  

 You will bridge research and engineering: evaluating suitable AI/ML techniques, training and fine\-tuning models, and integrating dependable AI services into the product. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, frontend engineers, product managers, and domain specialists to ensure each solution is accurate, scalable, explainable, and valuable to users.
   

 Key Responsibilities
   

* Research and evaluate AI/ML techniques relevant to procurement workflows, including forecasting, recommendations, document intelligence, and anomaly detection.
* Develop, train, evaluate, and fine\-tune models for use cases such as supplier scoring, spend analytics, and anomaly detection.
* Prepare high\-quality datasets for training and testing through cleaning, structuring, validation, and feature engineering.
* Build and integrate AI services into the product in collaboration with backend and frontend engineering teams.
* Translate product requirements and domain needs into well\-defined experiments, technical approaches, and measurable model objectives.
* Conduct experiments, benchmark models against suitable baselines, and communicate findings to support evidence\-based decisions.
* Optimise deployed models for accuracy, latency, reliability, scalability, and operational performance.
* Explore and implement agentic AI workflows that automate multi\-step procurement tasks and support informed decision\-making.
* Develop APIs or services that expose model capabilities reliably and securely to other parts of the platform.
* Monitor model and data performance after deployment, investigate degradation, and implement appropriate improvements.
* Maintain clear documentation for research, datasets, experiments, model behaviour, evaluation results, and implementations.
* Participate in code reviews, contribute to high engineering standards, and improve the reproducibility and maintainability of AI systems.


 Requirements
   

  

 Mandatory Requirements
   

* 2–4 years of professional experience in AI engineering, machine learning, data science, or a closely related role.
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience with ML libraries such as scikit\-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, or comparable tools.
* Sound understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, overfitting, validation, and evaluation metrics.
* Experience preparing and analysing data with pandas, NumPy, or similar libraries.
* Familiarity with model\-training workflows, hyperparameter tuning, cross\-validation, and experiment tracking.
* Ability to prepare reliable training and test datasets, including data cleaning, structuring, validation, and quality checks.
* Working knowledge of SQL for querying and analysing data.
* Foundational understanding of model deployment, inference, API integration, and production performance considerations.
* Experience using Git and working effectively within collaborative software\-development workflows.
* Ability to write clean, maintainable, well\-documented, and testable code.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to investigate complex data or model issues.
* Full\-time availability and willingness to work on\-site from Safal Softcom’s premises as an embedded member of the product team.


 What we care about
   

* Function over flash. We value straightforward, well\-reasoned solutions that solve real problems over unnecessary complexity or novelty.
* Reliability and reproducibility. Models must be well tested, documented, traceable, and dependable in production.
* Ownership. You will take responsibility for the quality and lifecycle of your work, from research and implementation to deployment and improvement.
* Business impact. We prioritise AI features that create measurable value for enterprise users and improve real procurement decisions or processes.
* Collaboration. Clear communication and productive teamwork across product, engineering, and domain teams are essential.
* Learning mindset. AI evolves quickly; we value people who remain curious, learn from experiments, and apply new knowledge thoughtfully.
* Scalability. You will consider data quality, cost, latency, model serving, and long\-term maintenance from the beginning.


 About You
   

 You are an early\-career AI engineer with a strong grounding in machine learning and an interest in applying it to complex, real\-world business problems. You enjoy moving between data, experiments, code, and product requirements, and you care as much about production usefulness as model performance.
   

  

 You take a pragmatic approach to problem\-solving. You understand that a model is only valuable when it can be deployed, monitored, understood by stakeholders, and maintained over time. You can balance accuracy, simplicity, explainability, and operational constraints without losing sight of the user and the business outcome.
   

  

 You communicate clearly, welcome feedback, and enjoy working closely with engineers and non\-technical colleagues. You are comfortable working through ambiguity, breaking large problems into manageable experiments, and building dependable systems within a collaborative product team.
   

  

  

  

 Benefits
   

  

 Growth at Jetbro
   


 If you do well, this role can grow into:
   




* Senior Backend Engineer
* Platform / Infrastructure Engineer
* System Architect (longer term)


 We invest heavily in people who invest in learning.

title: Software Development Engineer - I (Fullstack)
description:
This is a core developer and a product\-facing builder in one — effectively a product engineer. At the core you're a strong developer, but you lead with product thinking: you understand the customer and the problem before you write a line of code. You'll own solutions on aiRA, Capillary's agentic AI platform, end to end — sitting with customers, designing the solution, and building production\-ready agents yourself. We're looking for people who have already been building for the agentic world.
 



**What you'll do** 



* Build production\-ready agents and applications on aiRA — hands\-on, end to end.
* Lead with product thinking: understand the customer and the problem, then design the right solution.
* Work directly with customers to translate real workflows and automations into shipped agents.
* Own delivery end to end — design, build, ship, and iterate based on what customers actually do.
* Integrate against enterprise systems and the Capillary platform.



**Required qualifications** 



* 1\+ years of professional software engineering experience, hands\-on — you write and ship code.
* Strong developer core:
 **Python OR the MERN stack** 
 (MongoDB, Express, React, Node).
* Product thinking first — you understand and prioritise the customer problem, not just the implementation.
* Experience building for the agentic world — LLMs, agents, RAG, tool / function\-calling, and AI frameworks.
* Comfortable with APIs, system integrations and data modeling.



**Nice to have** 



* Customer\-facing or solutioning experience — you can scope a problem with a client and turn it into a build.
* Domain depth in one of our verticals (airline, hospitality, retail, fuel, FMCG).
* Has shipped an agentic product or application end to end.
* Has already worked in a similar forward\-deployed / product\-engineer role before.



**Soft skills** 



* Product\-first curiosity — you want to understand the customer and the problem, not just the tech.
* Strong ownership — you create the work and drive it end to end; you don't wait to be assigned it.
* Self\-directed builder — comfort with ambiguity, fast iteration, and wearing several hats. A cog\-in\-the\-wheel mindset won't thrive here.
