title: Junior Backend Developer | Event Discovery & Ticketing Platform
description:
**Junior Backend Developer
   

  

 1–3 years of experience**
**Location: Versova, Mumbai**
**Full\-time, in\-office role.**
*Build the systems and intelligence that power the live entertainment experience.*
**Company: thumpN**
 thumpN is an AI\-native discovery and ticketing platform that unifies discovery, ticketing, and on\-ground tools for fans, artists, venues, and promoters.
   

  

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**
**ThumpN Is Where The Show Begins.**
 At thumpN, we build products that make discovering and experiencing live entertainment effortless. Behind every event discovered, ticket purchased, and attendee checked into a venue is a backend system that needs to be fast, reliable, and intelligent.
   

  

 As we grow into new cities and categories, we need a backend developer who can help build the infrastructure and services that power these experiences—and increasingly, the AI systems that sit on top of them.
   

  

 This role is for someone who enjoys understanding how systems work, building reliable APIs and services, working with data, and experimenting with new ways of using AI to solve problems. You will work closely with Product, Frontend, and Engineering to build the systems behind discovery, ticketing, payments, events, and on\-ground experiences.
   

  

**What You’ll Actually Do**
**Backend Development**
* Build and ship backend services and APIs using Go (Golang).
* Design and implement clean, reliable, and maintainable APIs that power thumpN's web and mobile experiences.
* Work with frontend engineers to understand product requirements and build the services needed to support them.
* Write well\-structured code with appropriate error handling, validation, logging, and testing.
* Debug issues across services and understand how different parts of the backend interact.


**Data \& Databases**
* Work with both SQL and NoSQL databases to build and maintain data\-driven features.
* Write and optimise SQL queries and understand relational data modelling.
* Work with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, or similar technologies.
* Understand indexing, transactions, caching, data consistency, and basic database performance optimisation.
* Help design schemas and data models that can evolve as the product grows.


**APIs, Integrations \& Infrastructure**
* Build and integrate REST APIs and third\-party services.
* Work with services such as payments, authentication, notifications, maps, analytics, and other external APIs.
* Understand asynchronous processing, queues, background jobs, webhooks, and event\-driven architectures.
* Work with Git and modern software development workflows.
* Gain exposure to cloud infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, logging, and CI/CD.


**AI \& Agentic Workflows**
* Help build the next generation of AI\-native experiences at thumpN.
* Work with LLMs, AI APIs, agents, tools, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval\-based systems.
* Build and integrate agentic workflows where AI can reason through tasks, use tools, retrieve information, and take actions.
* Experiment with AI orchestration frameworks and patterns for building reliable AI workflows.
* Work with embeddings, vector databases, RAG, and other techniques for making AI systems useful with real product data.
* Understand how to design AI workflows with appropriate guardrails, validation, observability, and human intervention where required.
* Explore natural\-language programming and AI\-assisted development—using natural language to describe intent, generate code, query systems, automate workflows, and build product capabilities.
* Stay curious about rapidly evolving AI tooling and identify practical opportunities to use it within thumpN's products and internal systems.


**Product \& Engineering**
* Work closely with Product and Frontend engineers to understand the problem behind each feature.
* Participate in technical discussions and contribute to architectural decisions.
* Break larger problems into smaller, shippable pieces.
* Think about reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability—not just whether a feature works.
* Take ownership of backend features from development through release and iteration.


**What You Bring**
**Curiosity, strong fundamentals, and the drive to build**
**Required**
* 1–3 years of experience building backend services or applications.
* Strong programming fundamentals and hands\-on experience with Go (Golang).
* Understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, authentication, and common backend patterns.
* Experience working with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Understanding of NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, or similar.
* Good understanding of data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and error handling.
* Experience with Git and collaborative software development workflows.
* Ability to debug issues, read existing code, and understand how different services interact.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and an ownership mindset.
* Curiosity about AI, LLMs, and agentic systems, with an interest in learning how they can be used to build real products.


**Preferred**
* Experience building production services using Go.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, transactions, and query optimisation.
* Experience with NoSQL databases and caching systems such as MongoDB or Redis.
* Familiarity with message queues, event\-driven architecture, background jobs, or asynchronous processing.
* Experience with Docker, CI/CD, or cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Familiarity with observability tools, structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing.
* Experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar.
* Experience with function calling, tool use, structured outputs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or AI agents.
* Familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks or agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, context management, evaluation, and AI workflow design.
* Experience using AI\-assisted coding tools and natural\-language\-driven development workflows.
* Experience building consumer\-facing products, marketplaces, e\-commerce, ticketing, or high\-traffic applications.
* Passion for live entertainment, consumer technology, AI, and building systems that people actually use.


**NON\-NEGOTIABLES**
**How We Know This Is The Right Fit**
* You care about the product, not just the backend.


 You want to understand what you're building, who is using it, and why it matters. You don't see an API as just an endpoint—you understand the experience and product flow it enables.
   

  

* You have strong engineering fundamentals.


 You care about clean code, good abstractions, data modelling, error handling, testing, performance, and maintainability. You don't reach for complexity when a simple solution will work.
   

  

* You are curious about AI.


 You don't need to be an AI researcher. But you should be genuinely interested in how LLMs, agents, tools, and natural\-language interfaces are changing how software is built and how products work.
   

  

* You think in systems.


 You understand that a backend feature doesn't exist in isolation. You think about APIs, databases, queues, caching, external services, failure states, observability, and what happens when things don't go according to plan.
   

  

* You take ownership.


 When something breaks, you don't just point to where the problem might be. You investigate it, understand the root cause, fix it, and think about how to prevent it from happening again.
   

  

* You are comfortable learning.


 You won't know everything when you join. That's expected. What matters is that you can read documentation, experiment, ask good questions, and figure things out. Backend and AI technologies are evolving quickly, and we expect you to evolve with them.
   

  

* You communicate clearly and work well with others.


 Backend engineering doesn't happen in isolation. You will work closely with Product, Frontend, and other engineers. You ask when something isn't clear, explain your thinking, and raise problems before they become bigger problems.
   

  

* You want to build things people actually use.


 The goal isn't to build the most sophisticated architecture or use the newest AI framework. The goal is to build reliable systems and intelligent experiences that help people discover events, buy tickets, and have a better experience with live entertainment.
   

  

 Skills: go (golang),ticketing,backend development,entertainment

description:

 Living our values everyday results in our team\-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

 **Product Manager Apprentice** 
 to join our Product Management team working on next\-generation
 **Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS)**

 **AI\-driven customer experience technologies and modern cloud\-native architectures** 
 .
   

  

 As a Product Manager Apprentice, you will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, UX, Data Science, and GTM teams to define, build, and scale features across our CCaaS product lines — including

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
****What You'll Do****
 As a Deployment Strategist at Wonderful, you are responsible for making AI deployments actually land.
   

  

 Wonderful is the AI operating system for enterprises, helping them close the gap between what AI enables and how they operate today. You lead enterprise customers from early discovery through pilot and production rollout, translating ambitious AI initiatives into clear scopes, executable plans, and measurable outcomes. You sit between the customer, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Product, ensuring everyone is aligned on what is being built, why it matters, and how it will succeed in production.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role for people who enjoy ambiguity, ownership, and seeing complex projects through to the end.
   

  

* Embed deeply with customers to understand their processes and systems, identify the most important problems to solve, and obsess over helping them win.
* Lead discovery with enterprise customers to understand workflows, constraints, and success criteria.
* Define scope, success metrics, and integration plans for pilots and rollouts.
* Translate customer needs into clear deployment plans for engineering teams.
* Coordinate deployments across Product, Engineering, and customer stakeholders.
* Track progress, manage risks, and remove blockers throughout the deployment.
* Support production launches and ensure solutions are adopted and working as intended.
* Monitor deployed agents and drive follow\-up improvements based on real usage.
* Identify additional use cases and expansion opportunities with customers.


 You will spend time onsite with customers, working through real constraints, answering difficult questions, and ensuring solutions deliver real value.
   

  

****Why Should You****
* You’ll be part of what is tipped as the fastest\-growing startup in Europe.
* Work on a cutting\-edge agentic solution, the hottest topic in Enterprise right now.
* You’ll join a team of high\-agency builders coming from the best tech companies out there.
* Never boring \- you’ll be solving problems for and with the biggest Enterprises in the world.


****Who You Are****
* Experience in deployment\-focused, technical, or execution\-oriented roles.
* Strong ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into concrete plans.
* Comfort working with technical concepts such as APIs, MCP, data flows, and system integrations.
* Clear communication and strong stakeholder management skills.
* High ownership mindset and bias toward action.
* Interest in building and deploying AI\-powered systems in real environments.


****Nice To Have****
* Background in solutions engineering, technical consulting, or forward\-deployed roles.
* Prior hands\-on engineering experience.
* Experience supporting production software launches.
* Experience working in high\-growth or early\-stage environments.


****Why This Role Exists****
 Enterprises are ready to use AI, but execution is the hard part.
   

  

 This role exists to bridge that gap. You will help customers deploy AI agents that integrate with real systems, respect real constraints, and deliver measurable outcomes.

description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a UI/UX Designer based in India.**
 You’ll design intuitive, engaging digital learning experiences used by students and educators around the world.
   

  

 The role covers the full product design lifecycle, from ambiguous problems and user flows to polished interfaces and shipped experiences.
   

  

 You’ll work extensively on AI\-powered and personalized learning features while ensuring users remain informed and in control.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate closely with product, engineering, design, and learning experts in a fast\-moving, highly iterative environment.
   

  

 The position combines strong visual and interaction design with product thinking, prototyping, accessibility, and design systems.
   

  

 You’ll have significant ownership and the opportunity to experiment with modern AI\-powered design and development tools.
   

  

 This is an ideal environment for a designer who wants to create meaningful products rather than simply produce static screens.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Design intuitive UI/UX experiences for AI\-powered EdTech web and mobile applications serving students and educators.
* Own product design initiatives end to end, including problem framing, user flows, wireframes, high\-fidelity designs, prototypes, and iteration through launch.
* Design AI and LLM\-powered features that reduce user effort while preserving human control through appropriate review, editing, undo, feedback, and recovery experiences.
* Use modern design, AI, and prototyping tools such as Figma, Claude Design, and Lovable to rapidly explore concepts and create working prototypes.
* Build and maintain reusable components, variants, and design tokens to create consistent, scalable product experiences.
* Apply accessibility principles throughout the design process, including clear labeling, keyboard navigation, focus states, sufficient contrast, meaningful error messaging, and status indicators that do not rely solely on color in line with WCAG 2\.2 AA.
* Create mobile\-first, responsive experiences that work effectively across smartphones, tablets, and desktop environments.
* Produce detailed, engineering\-ready handoffs covering user flows, interface states, validation rules, and component specifications.
* Collaborate closely with designers, engineers, product managers, and learning specialists through rapid iteration cycles to improve user journeys and product outcomes.
* Contribute ideas, experimentation, and momentum within a small, ownership\-driven product team.


**Requirements**
* Demonstrated experience in product design with a strong portfolio showcasing shipped web and mobile experiences and the reasoning behind design decisions.
* Strong proficiency in Figma and solid visual and interaction design skills, including hierarchy, spacing, typography, responsive layouts, and interface states.
* Strong product thinking, with the ability to challenge assumptions, clarify ambiguous requirements, and prioritize the experiences and features that matter most.
* Genuine interest in AI\-enhanced and personalized user experiences, particularly designing interactions that keep users informed and in control of AI\-generated outcomes.
* Experience or strong willingness to work with modern AI\-powered design and prototyping tools and continuously experiment as the technology evolves.
* Systems\-thinking approach to design, with experience creating reusable components, variants, design tokens, and scalable design patterns rather than one\-off screens.
* Strong understanding of accessibility and a commitment to designing inclusive experiences for diverse users.
* Ability to work independently, make decisions with incomplete information, and move effectively without highly prescriptive instructions.
* Ownership\-oriented, curious, collaborative mindset with the energy and adaptability required in a fast\-moving product environment.
* Experience designing for EdTech, students, teachers, or classroom environments is a strong advantage.
* Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library is a plus.
* Ability to prototype using HTML/CSS, React, or tools such as Lovable is an advantage.
* Experience designing AI\-powered product features, including failure states, guardrails, human review, and recovery flows, is a plus.


**Benefits**
* Fully remote position available to candidates based in India.
* Competitive compensation.
* High degree of ownership over product design and user experiences.
* Opportunity to work on AI\-powered learning products with global reach.
* Small, collaborative team with a focus on meaningful product development rather than corporate bureaucracy.
* Freedom to experiment with modern AI design, prototyping, and development tools.
* Environment that encourages creativity, curiosity, speed, and continuous learning.
* Opportunity to contribute to technology that can make learning more engaging, personalized, accessible, and effective.

description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Medical Writer based in India.**
 This role offers an opportunity to contribute to medical imaging clinical trials by creating high\-quality scientific and operational documentation.
   

  

 You will support study startup, documentation development, compliance activities, and clinical research operations across global projects.
   

  

 Working closely with cross\-functional teams, you will help translate study requirements into clear, accurate, and compliant materials.
   

  

 Your work will contribute to document quality, study readiness, operational efficiency, and successful clinical trial execution.
   

  

 The position provides exposure to medical writing, clinical research, regulatory documentation, and imaging sciences.
   

  

 You will work in a collaborative environment where attention to detail, organization, and continuous improvement are highly valued.
   

  

 This is a strong opportunity for an early\-career scientific professional looking to develop expertise while contributing to therapies that can improve patients’ lives.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Study Startup Support: Create, organize, and maintain study\-specific medical writing and medical communications documentation required for study initiation and execution.
* Protocol \& Imaging Review: Review study protocols and imaging requirements to accurately interpret procedures, schedules, and operational requirements.
* Clinical Documentation: Create, update, review, and finalize Site Manuals, supporting forms, labels, communication materials, and other study\-specific documentation.
* Quality \& Compliance: Develop and maintain Notes to File, protocol amendment impact assessments, corrections, quality records, and other compliance\-related documentation.
* Source Documentation: Create and maintain source documents and electronic clinical forms that support study execution and operational requirements.
* Meeting \& Project Support: Prepare agendas, meeting minutes, action items, and other documentation for study startup, project, and medical communications activities.
* Medical Communications: Maintain and enhance communication resources, databases, web content, and document repositories.
* Closeout \& Archiving: Support project closeout and ensure study documentation is archived accurately in accordance with internal procedures and applicable requirements.
* SOPs \& Training: Contribute to the development, review, and maintenance of SOPs, Work Instructions, templates, training materials, reader training content, and educational resources.
* Document Control: Maintain study tracking tools, document status reports, and medical writing databases to support accurate reporting and document control.
* Cross\-Functional Guidance: Provide project teams with guidance on documentation processes, templates, and study\-specific requirements.
* Continuous Improvement: Participate in initiatives designed to improve quality, compliance, efficiency, documentation practices, and operational excellence.


**Requirements**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Biological Sciences, Physical Sciences, Pharmacy, Healthcare, Clinical Research, or another relevant scientific discipline is preferred.
* Medical Writing Experience: 1\+ year of medical writing experience is preferred; equivalent experience in clinical research or scientific documentation may also be considered.
* Industry Experience: 2\+ years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research, healthcare, medical imaging, or a related industry is preferred.
* Scientific Writing: Understanding of medical, clinical research, regulatory, and/or scientific writing principles.
* Clinical Research Knowledge: Familiarity with clinical trial terminology, clinical research processes, and medical imaging concepts is advantageous.
* Technical Skills: Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and related productivity tools.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly across global and cross\-functional teams.
* Quality Orientation: Exceptional attention to detail, proofreading, editing, and document quality review skills.
* Organization: Strong organizational and time\-management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Independence \& Collaboration: Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within collaborative, global teams.
* Adaptability: Comfortable adjusting to changing priorities and working effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Professional Approach: Proactive, customer\-focused, quality\-oriented, and committed to continuous improvement.


**Benefits**
* Competitive pay and incentives.
* Provident fund.
* Medical insurance.
* Remote work flexibility.
* Modern office facilities in Bangalore.

title: GCP Infra Security (GCP + AI+ DevSecOps) - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever\-changing threat landscape. Through powerful insights and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable businesses to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure achievements.
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Level:** 
 Solution Advisor
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 As a Consultant, you will be supporting the clients with their Cyber needs specifically helping them protect and secure their Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure . This will include:
   

  

* Assist in designing and implementing secure Google Cloud Platform infrastructure solutions under the guidance of senior consultants and managers.
* Support security assessments, threat modeling, and risk analysis activities for client GCP environments.
* Help review and update Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies, service account configurations, VPC architectures, and firewall rules.
* Contribute to integrating security tools and controls into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows.
* Support the configuration and tuning of cloud\-native security services, such as VPC Service Controls, Cloud Armor, IAM, and Security Command Center.
* Help develop and maintain secure Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) templates using tools like Terraform or Deployment Manager.
* Assist in implementing security controls and processes to help client environments meet relevant security standards and frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS).
* Collaborate with client stakeholders and internal teams to align security activities with business objectives.
* Help prepare documentation and training materials to support client teams in managing their GCP security posture.
* Support GCP Security, Compliance \& Controls initiatives, including governance, identity, network security, and data protection.
* Understanding of Wiz for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP), container and Kubernetes security, vulnerability management, and risk prioritization.
* Assist in securing AI and GenAI workloads on GCP, including Vertex AI and Gemini\-based environments, by supporting the implementation of controls across access management, data protection, prompt security, and logging and monitoring.
* Contribute to the secure operation of AI/ML services by leveraging GCP native and AI assisted security capabilities, including Security Command Center insights, threat detection, and risk prioritization.


**The Team:**
 Enterprise Security teams embed security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client’s “technical backbone” while also enabling secure digital transformation. Services include security architecture, secure development and deployment, end\-to\-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products. Examples of work include Secure by Design, Cloud Security Orchestration \& Automation, Core Infrastructure Security, and Secure Software Enablement.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* 4\+ years of experience in cloud security or cloud infrastructure, with hands\-on exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its security features.
* Familiarity with designing and implementing secure GCP architectures, preferably as part of a team.
* Understanding of cloud security principles, such as least\-privilege access and zero\-trust concepts.
* Experience with GCP networking, IAM, data protection and related security controls.
* Exposure to infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager).
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating security controls.
* Proficiency with scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) for automation tasks.
* Knowledge of container security (e.g., GKE, Kubernetes RBAC, image scanning) is a plus.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to contribute to client discussions and documentation.
* Understanding of AI/GenAI security on GCP, including Vertex AI and Gemini\-based environments, with knowledge of access control, data protection, prompt security, and logging and monitoring practices.
* Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI, and compliance requirements, along with GCP\-native security capabilities to support model risk management, threat detection, and risk prioritization across AI/ML solutions.


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Relevant security certifications (e.g., GCP Associate Cloud Engineer, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CompTIA Security\+) are a plus.
* Awareness of Vertex AI, Generative AI, and AI security concepts, including governance, data privacy, and responsible AI practices.
* Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, CIS, or MITRE ATT\&CK, and applying them to GCP environments.


**Education:**
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, or equivalent experience.


**Location:**
* Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata


 \#FY27CyberCampaign
   

  

 \#CyberEnterpriseSecurity
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. title: Senior Embedded Engineer
description:
**Job Description** 




**Ciklum** 
 is looking for a
 **Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer** 
 to join our team full\-time in India.
 



 We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
 



**About The Role** 




 As a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer, become a part of a cross\-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Designing and developing embedded firmware for IoT devices using C/C\+\+ and assembly language
* Implementing communication protocols including Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, Zigbee, LoRaWAN, and cellular connectivity
* Optimizing power consumption and performance for battery\-powered IoT devices
* Collaborating with hardware engineers to define system architecture and component selection
* Developing and maintaining real\-time operating systems (RTOS) applications
* Implementing secure boot processes and encryption protocols for device security
* Creating comprehensive testing frameworks and debugging procedures
* Working closely with cloud and mobile app teams to ensure seamless device integration



**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
* 4\+ years of experience in embedded firmware development
* 2\+ years of hands\-on IoT development experience
* Proficiency in C/C\+\+ programming for embedded systems
* Experience with microcontrollers (ARM Cortex\-M, ESP32, STM32, etc.)
* Strong knowledge of wireless communication protocols (Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular)
* Experience with RTOS (FreeRTOS, ThreadX, etc.)
* Understanding of low\-power design techniques and power management
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and agile development methodologies
* Knowledge of IoT security best practices and implementation



**Desirable** 



* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT, Google Cloud IoT)
* Knowledge of edge computing and machine learning on embedded devices
* Familiarity with industrial IoT protocols (Modbus, CAN bus, OPC\-UA)
* Experience with containerization and OTA update mechanisms
* Previous experience in product development lifecycle
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills



**What\`s in it for you?** 



* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large\-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations



**About Us** 




 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
 



 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
 



 Want to learn more about us? Follow us on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn.
 



**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!** 




 Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

title: HR and Admin Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONStrategic HR Manager – Workforce Productivity \& HR Operations

**Department:** Human Resources  
**Designation:** Strategic HR Manager  
**Industry:** Information Technology  
**Reports To:** Head of HR / Managing Director  
**Location:** \[Location]  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

1\. Job Purpose

The **Strategic HR Manager** will be responsible for managing and strengthening the complete employee lifecycle while driving **workforce productivity, HR operations, payroll, onboarding, employee engagement, compliance, and performance management**.

The role requires a strategic HR professional who can connect people practices with business objectives, improve employee productivity, establish efficient HR systems, and ensure smooth day\-to\-day HR administration within the IT organization.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Strategic HR Management

* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with the company's business objectives.
* Support management in workforce planning, organizational development, and people strategy.
* Analyze workforce requirements and recommend appropriate staffing levels.
* Develop HR policies, procedures, and employee guidelines.
* Identify HR risks and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide management with HR reports, dashboards, and actionable insights.

B. Workforce Productivity \& Performance

* Monitor employee productivity, utilization, attendance, and workforce efficiency.
* Establish **KPIs, KRAs, and performance measurement systems** for different departments.
* Track individual and team performance against defined targets.
* Identify productivity gaps and coordinate improvement plans.
* Develop performance improvement plans (PIPs) wherever required.
* Monitor employee workload, resource allocation, overtime, absenteeism, and attrition.
* Work closely with department heads to improve team productivity.
* Prepare monthly workforce productivity reports for management.
* Recommend process improvements to reduce manpower costs and improve efficiency.

C. Payroll Management

* Manage and coordinate the complete monthly payroll process.
* Verify attendance, leave, overtime, incentives, deductions, and salary revisions before payroll processing.
* Ensure accurate calculation of salaries, reimbursements, bonuses, and other employee benefits.
* Coordinate with Finance/Accounts for timely payroll processing.
* Maintain payroll records and employee salary documentation.
* Ensure payroll confidentiality and data accuracy.
* Handle employee payroll\-related queries and resolve discrepancies.
* Support statutory payroll requirements such as **PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS**, and other applicable compliances.

D. Employee Onboarding

* Manage the complete employee onboarding process from offer acceptance to joining.
* Coordinate documentation, background verification, employment agreements, and joining formalities.
* Ensure employee profiles are created in HRMS and other required systems.
* Coordinate with IT/Admin for email IDs, system access, laptops, ID cards, and other assets.
* Conduct HR induction and explain company policies, procedures, benefits, and code of conduct.
* Establish an effective **30/60/90\-day onboarding and integration process**.
* Track probation and confirmation timelines.

E. HR Administration

* Maintain accurate and updated employee records and HR databases.
* Manage attendance, leave, shift schedules, holidays, and employee movements.
* Issue HR letters including appointment, confirmation, promotion, increment, transfer, warning, experience, relieving, and other employment\-related letters.
* Maintain employee personal files and HR documentation.
* Manage employee lifecycle transactions such as joining, transfers, promotions, salary revisions, and exits.
* Ensure HR documentation is properly maintained and confidential.
* Implement HRMS and digital HR processes to reduce manual work.

F. Employee Engagement \& Retention

* Develop employee engagement initiatives suitable for an IT workforce.
* Conduct employee feedback surveys and engagement activities.
* Identify factors affecting employee satisfaction and retention.
* Conduct employee interaction meetings and address workplace concerns.
* Support management in developing employee recognition and reward programs.
* Monitor employee turnover and conduct **exit interviews and attrition analysis**.
* Develop retention strategies for critical and high\-performing employees.

G. Recruitment \& Workforce Planning

* Work with department heads to identify current and future manpower requirements.
* Prepare manpower plans based on business growth and project requirements.
* Coordinate recruitment activities with internal/external recruiters.
* Monitor recruitment metrics including **Time\-to\-Hire, Cost\-per\-Hire, Offer\-to\-Join Ratio, and Quality of Hire**.
* Ensure timely hiring of critical technical and non\-technical positions.
* Maintain talent pipelines for key positions.

H. Learning \& Development

* Identify employee skill gaps through performance reviews and manager feedback.
* Coordinate technical and behavioral training programs.
* Develop annual training and development plans.
* Track training effectiveness and employee development.
* Support career development and succession planning initiatives.

I. HR Policies \& Compliance

* Develop, implement, and periodically review HR policies.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour and employment laws.
* Maintain statutory registers and HR compliance documentation as applicable.
* Ensure proper implementation of company policies across departments.
* Handle disciplinary matters in accordance with company policy and applicable law.
* Maintain proper documentation of warnings, disciplinary actions, and employee grievances.

J. Employee Relations

* Act as a trusted HR point of contact for employees and management.
* Handle employee grievances professionally and confidentially.
* Mediate workplace conflicts and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Maintain a positive and productive work environment.
* Ensure consistent and fair application of HR policies.

K. Exit \& Full \& Final Settlement

* Manage the complete employee exit process.
* Conduct exit interviews and document employee feedback.
* Coordinate resignation acceptance, notice period, handover, clearance, and asset recovery.
* Coordinate with Finance for **Full \& Final Settlement (F\&F)**.
* Ensure timely issuance of relieving and experience letters.
* Analyze exit trends and recommend retention measures.

3\. HR Metrics \& MIS

The Strategic HR Manager will be responsible for preparing and monitoring key HR dashboards, including:

* Employee Headcount \& Workforce Cost
* Employee Productivity \& Utilization
* Attendance \& Absenteeism
* Employee Attrition \& Retention
* Recruitment Status
* Time\-to\-Hire
* Cost\-per\-Hire
* Offer\-to\-Joining Ratio
* Employee Turnover
* Payroll Cost
* Overtime / Additional Manpower Cost
* Leave Utilization
* Performance Rating Distribution
* Training \& Development Metrics
* Employee Engagement
* Probation \& Confirmation Status

4\. Technology \& HR Systems

* Manage and optimize the organization's **HRMS / HRIS**.
* Ensure employee data is accurately maintained in HR systems.
* Automate attendance, leave, payroll, onboarding, and performance processes wherever possible.
* Generate HR dashboards and reports for management.
* Maintain data accuracy, confidentiality, and access controls.
* Identify technology solutions that can improve HR efficiency and employee experience.

5\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Strategic HR Manager will be evaluated based on:

* **Workforce Productivity Improvement**
* Payroll Accuracy \& Timeliness
* Employee Attendance \& Absenteeism Management
* Recruitment Turnaround Time
* Employee Retention \& Attrition Reduction
* Onboarding Effectiveness
* Employee Engagement
* HR Process Automation
* HR Compliance
* Employee Grievance Resolution
* Performance Management Effectiveness
* Accuracy and Timeliness of HR MIS
* Reduction in HR Operational Costs
* Employee Satisfaction \& Experience

6\. Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
* **MBA / PGDM in HR** preferred.
* Strong knowledge of HR operations, payroll, employee lifecycle management, and performance management.
* Working knowledge of applicable labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets and HRMS platforms.

7\. Experience

* **5–8 years of progressive HR experience**, preferably in an IT/software/services organization.
* Minimum **2–3 years in an HR Manager / Strategic HR / HR Operations leadership role** preferred.
* Experience managing HR operations for a growing workforce is highly desirable.
* Experience with HRMS, payroll systems, performance management, and workforce analytics preferred.

8\. Key Competencies

* Strategic Thinking
* Workforce Planning
* People Analytics
* Workforce Productivity Management
* Payroll \& HR Operations
* Performance Management
* Employee Relations
* Leadership \& Team Management
* Problem Solving
* Decision Making
* Communication \& Negotiation
* Conflict Resolution
* Data Analysis
* Process Improvement
* Confidentiality \& Professional Integrity

9\. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be **both strategic and hands\-on**—capable of developing HR strategies at the management level while personally ensuring that payroll, onboarding, attendance, employee records, performance management, and daily HR operations run smoothly.

The candidate should have a strong **business\-oriented HR mindset**, using employee and workforce data to identify problems, improve productivity, control manpower costs, and build a high\-performance culture within the IT organization.

We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Vehicle and Machinery Valuator to assess the value and condition of vehicles, heavy equipment, industrial machinery, and other mechanical assets. The successful candidate will conduct physical inspections, analyze market data, determine fair market values, and prepare accurate valuation reports for clients, financial institutions, insurance companies, or internal business purposes.

* Maintain accurate records of inspections, calculations, market research, and valuation conclusions.
* Communicate valuation findings clearly to clients and other stakeholders.
* Conduct site visits to workshops, yards, construction sites, factories, dealerships, and other locations when required.
* Keep up to date with changes in vehicle, machinery, and equipment markets.
* Ensure valuations are conducted in accordance with applicable company procedures and professional standards.

* Relevant experience in vehicle appraisal, machinery valuation, equipment inspection, automotive, engineering, insurance, banking, or asset management.
* Good knowledge of different types of vehicles, construction equipment, agricultural machinery, and industrial machinery.

title: Manufacturing / Process Engineer – XR Hardware
description:
Manufacturing / Process Engineer – XR Hardware

Company: US\-Based Technology Company

Work Location: Fun Republic Area, Andheri West, Mumbai

Employment Type: Full\-Time \| On\-Site

Experience: Freshers Welcome

Education: B.E./B.Tech in Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Electronics, Manufacturing Engineering or related discipline

About the Opportunity

A US\-based technology company is hiring engineers in Mumbai to develop and manufacture a next\-generation immersive entertainment headset.

We are looking for a Manufacturing / Process Engineer who will help transform an engineering prototype into a product that can be assembled, tested and manufactured repeatedly at consistent quality.

Fresh graduates with strong manufacturing, robotics, automation, mechanical, electronics or production\-engineering projects are encouraged to apply.

What You Will Work On

You will help take the product through:

→ Manufacturing Process → Assembly Stations → SOPs → Pilot Line → Quality Improvement → Production Scale\-Up

Key Responsibilities

1\. Design the Manufacturing Process

You will define how the headset should actually be assembled.

This includes establishing the correct sequence for:

Component Inspection → Electronics Assembly → Display/Optics Integration → Sensors/Cameras → Battery → Audio → Body Assembly → Firmware → Calibration → Testing → Final QC → Packaging

The objective is to make every production unit follow a documented and repeatable process.

1\. Assembly Line Development

Help design and establish the initial headset assembly line.

Responsibilities include:

Determine the number of assembly stations.

Define the work performed at each station.

Create workstation layouts.

Determine required tools and equipment.

Define operator movement and material flow.

Reduce unnecessary handling.

Establish cycle\-time targets.

Identify production bottlenecks.

Improve line efficiency as volumes increase.

1\. Develop SOPs

Create detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for each manufacturing operation.

For example:

SOP\-01: Incoming component inspection

SOP\-02: Main board installation

SOP\-03: Display installation

SOP\-04: Optical module installation

SOP\-05: Camera/sensor assembly

SOP\-06: Battery installation

SOP\-07: Audio assembly

SOP\-08: Headset body assembly

SOP\-09: Firmware flashing

SOP\-10: Calibration

SOP\-11: Functional testing

SOP\-12: Final inspection and packaging

SOPs should include tools, process steps, photographs/diagrams, tolerances, safety requirements and acceptance criteria.

1\. Jigs, Fixtures \& Tools

Work with hardware and mechanical engineers to develop production tools such as:

Assembly fixtures

Alignment jigs

Optical positioning fixtures

PCB holding fixtures

Torque\-controlled screwdrivers

Adhesive dispensing tools

Calibration fixtures

Test fixtures

Device holding fixtures

Go/No\-Go gauges

You should continuously look for opportunities to replace manual judgment with a controlled process.

1\. ESD\-Safe Manufacturing

XR headsets contain sensitive electronic components.

You will help establish:

ESD\-safe workbenches

Grounding systems

ESD wrist straps

Anti\-static mats

Component handling procedures

ESD\-safe storage

Operator training

ESD compliance checks

1\. Optical Assembly Environment

Work with the Optics \& Display Engineer to establish appropriate processes for handling displays and lenses.

This includes:

Dust\-control procedures

Optical cleaning stations

Gloves and handling procedures

Lens/display inspection

Controlled storage

Cleaning materials

Optical assembly SOPs

The objective is to prevent dust, fingerprints and contamination from becoming trapped inside the headset.

1\. Production Quality \& Yield

Track manufacturing performance using measurable data.

You will monitor:

First\-pass yield

Rework rate

Reject rate

Assembly time

Defects per unit

Station\-level failures

Component failures

Operator\-related defects

You will work with QA and hardware engineering to continuously improve that number.

1\. Root\-Cause Analysis

When manufacturing problems occur, you will help determine why.

Examples:

Display not functioning after assembly

Flex cable damaged during installation

Lens misalignment

Loose connectors

Incorrect screw torque

Housing not closing correctly

Battery connection failure

Dust inside optical assembly

Camera alignment problems

Use structured methods such as:

5 Why **Fishbone Analysis**  Pareto Analysis **CAPA**

and convert findings into process improvements.

1\. Design for Manufacturing

Work with the Mechanical, Electronics and Hardware Product engineers before designs are finalized.

Ask questions such as:

Can operators assemble this easily?

Can the connector be reached?

Can the cable be installed without damage?

Are there too many screws?

Can parts be installed incorrectly?

Can assembly be simplified?

Can a jig eliminate alignment errors?

Can the device be repaired without destroying it?

This is Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA).

1\. Production Traceability

Help establish a digital record for every headset.

Each device should have a unique serial number linked to information such as:

Device Serial Number → PCB Batch → Display Batch → Optics Batch → Battery Batch → Assembly Date → Firmware Version → Calibration Result → QA Result

This becomes extremely important when devices reach customers.

This includes line balancing, automation, additional stations, operator planning and production\-capacity analysis.

Skills We Are Looking For

Strong fundamentals in any combination of:

Manufacturing processes

Production engineering

Industrial engineering

Electronics assembly

Mechanical assembly

Process engineering

Quality control

Engineering drawings

Basic CAD

Lean Manufacturing

5S

Root\-cause analysis

Production planning

Basic knowledge of electronics is particularly useful because this is an electronics manufacturing environment.

Bonus Skills

Exposure to any of these is valuable:

Manufacturing **Six Sigma**  5S **Kaizen**  FMEA **DFM/DFA**  SPC **AutoCAD**  SolidWorks **Python**  Excel/Data Analysis **Electronics Assembly**  ESD

These are desirable—not mandatory for freshers.

Freshers Are Welcome

We are particularly interested in graduates who have participated in:

Formula Student / BAJA

Robotics competitions

Manufacturing projects

Automation projects

Production\-line projects

3D printing

Electronics assembly

Industrial internships

College workshops

Product\-development projects

We value engineers who enjoy being on the production floor and solving real physical problems, rather than only preparing reports.

We are looking for an Optics \& Display Engineer who will help create the visual experience inside the headset.

This role sits at the intersection of optics, displays, electronics, human vision and XR technology. You will work with high\-resolution displays, pancake lenses and optical modules to achieve a sharp, comfortable and cinema\-quality immersive viewing experience.

Fresh graduates with strong optics, photonics, imaging, display or physics projects are encouraged to apply.

What You Will Work On

You will help develop the visual system from:

Display Selection → Lens Selection → Optical Integration → Alignment → Calibration → Visual Testing → Production Validation

Key Responsibilities

Display Technology

Research and evaluate high\-resolution display technologies for XR headsets.

Work with Micro\-OLED, OLED and fast LCD technologies.

Compare display modules based on:Resolution

Pixel density

Brightness

Contrast

Refresh rate

Color performance

Latency

Power consumption

Thermal performance

Work with display suppliers and evaluate engineering samples.

Support display integration with the electronics team.

XR Optics

Evaluate and integrate optical systems including:

Pancake lenses **Aspheric lenses**  Fresnel systems **Other emerging XR optics**

You will help determine the right optical architecture for long\-duration immersive entertainment.

You will work on:

Field of View (FOV)

Pixels Per Degree (PPD)

Eye relief

Exit pupil

IPD

Focus

Lens\-to\-display distance

Optical distortion

Chromatic aberration

Edge\-to\-edge clarity

Glare and reflections

Visual comfort

180° Immersive Cinema Optimization

SilverScreenX is being developed specifically around immersive entertainment.

You will work closely with the XR software engineer to optimize the headset for:

Stereoscopic 180° movies

Immersive video

Sports

Concerts

Live entertainment

Long\-duration viewing

The goal is not simply to achieve impressive specifications on paper. The objective is to make content look sharp, natural and comfortable for extended viewing periods.

Optical Alignment

Small errors in display/lens positioning can significantly affect XR image quality.

You will help define:

Lens alignment

Display alignment

Optical\-axis alignment

Lens/display spacing

IPD geometry

Mechanical tolerances

Calibration procedures

You will work closely with the Mechanical Engineer to ensure the physical headset maintains these tolerances during manufacturing.

Optical Calibration

You will help develop a repeatable calibration process for every headset.

For example:

Headset → Display Test Pattern → Camera/Measurement → Distortion Analysis → Calibration → Verification → PASS/FAIL

As production grows, this process should become increasingly automated.

Visual Quality Testing

You will investigate issues such as:

Blur

Distortion

Color mismatch

Uneven brightness

Dead/stuck pixels

Glare

Ghosting

Chromatic aberration

Poor edge clarity

Incorrect focus

Eye strain

Stereo mismatch

You will help establish measurable acceptance criteria for production devices.

Optical Cleanliness

Because lenses and displays are extremely sensitive to contamination, you will help define:

Optical cleaning procedures

Dust\-control requirements

Display handling procedures

Lens handling procedures

Assembly cleanliness standards

Inspection processes

For production, you will work with the Manufacturing Engineer to create a controlled optical assembly/calibration area.

Supplier \& Vendor Evaluation

You will interact with display and optics suppliers to:

Request samples

Compare optical modules

Review specifications

Test reference designs

Evaluate quality consistency

Define acceptable tolerances

Compare cost and MOQ

Identify alternative suppliers

Resolve quality problems

You will help the company decide whether to use a ready\-made optical module, semi\-custom module or eventually a more customized optical system.

Prototype Development

During early development, you will work hands\-on with:

Display modules

Lens assemblies

XR reference headsets

Optical prototypes

Mechanical test fixtures

Calibration equipment

You will participate directly in prototype builds rather than working only on theoretical simulations.

Tools \& Technical Knowledge

Exposure to any of the following is valuable:

Geometric optics

Physical optics

Imaging systems

Display technology

Photometry

Color science

Optical measurement

Image processing

MATLAB

Python

Zemax / OpticStudio

Code V or similar optical\-design software

Python/MATLAB skills are particularly useful for analyzing calibration and measurement data.

Freshers Are Welcome

Professional XR experience is not mandatory.

We are particularly interested in candidates with academic or personal projects involving:

Optics **Photonics**  Lasers **Imaging**  Cameras **Displays**  Computer Vision **AR/VR**  Optical Instruments **Image Processing**  Color Science

Candidates should be prepared to discuss their project work and explain the underlying physics and engineering.

What We Look For

We want someone who:

Has strong fundamentals in optics/physics.

Is obsessed with visual quality and details.

Enjoys experimental work.

Can measure rather than simply judge by eye.

Is comfortable working with hardware prototypes.

Can analyze data and troubleshoot problems.

Wants to learn XR display technology.

Can work closely with mechanical, electronics and software engineers.

**Role Description**

Zorabian Chicken is looking for an all round creative to own our social media output end to end across design, video, AI content, publishing and reporting. This is a hands on role. You will shoot it, edit it, design it, post it, read the numbers, and improve it.

● Experience with quick commerce creative formats.

● Experience designing for print alongside digital.

We are looking for a Mechanical \& Thermal Design Engineer who is passionate about designing physical products and wants to work on the actual body, internal structure, ergonomics and cooling architecture of an advanced XR headset.

You will work closely with electronics, optics, embedded software, industrial design and manufacturing teams to transform electronic and optical components into a comfortable, lightweight and manufacturable consumer device.

Fresh graduates with strong CAD, mechanical design, 3D\-printing or product\-development projects are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Headset Mechanical Design

Develop front housing, rear housing and internal structural components.

Define screw locations, clips, connectors and assembly mechanisms.

Headset Body \& Industrialization

Responsibilities include:

Develop 3D CAD models.

Create detailed engineering drawings.

Design plastic components.

Select appropriate engineering plastics and materials.

Work with prototype and injection\-molding vendors.

Review vendor tooling proposals.

Evaluate ready\-made headset bodies where appropriate.

Modify existing vendor chassis for product requirements.

Support development of custom parts when required.

Ergonomics \& Comfort

An entertainment headset may be worn continuously for an entire movie, making comfort extremely important.

You will work on:

Overall headset weight

Front/rear weight balance

Centre of gravity

Facial pressure distribution

Head strap geometry

Face cushion/interface

Nose clearance

Ventilation

Different head sizes

Prescription\-glasses compatibility

Long\-duration wearing comfort

You will conduct physical fit tests and convert user feedback into mechanical improvements.

Thermal Engineering

High\-performance XR processors and displays generate significant heat inside a compact enclosure.

You will help design the thermal\-management system.

Responsibilities include:

Identify major heat\-generating components.

Design thermal paths from processor/display electronics to the enclosure.

Evaluate heat sinks, graphite sheets, thermal pads, heat spreaders and heat pipes.

Evaluate passive versus active cooling.

Design airflow and ventilation paths.

Measure surface temperatures.

Conduct sustained\-load thermal tests.

Prevent excessive heat reaching the user's face.

The objective is to maintain performance while keeping the headset safe, quiet and comfortable.

Prototype Development

3D Printing → CNC → Vacuum Casting → Prototype Tooling → Injection Molding

Prepare CAD files for prototypes.

Work directly with prototype vendors.

Assemble prototype bodies.

Measure component fit and tolerances.

Identify interference and assembly problems.

Modify designs based on test results.

Maintain design revisions.

Design for Manufacturing

Design for Manufacturing (DFM)

Design for Assembly (DFA)

Injection\-molding considerations

Draft angles

Wall thickness

Ribs and bosses

Snap fits

Screw bosses

Tolerance stack\-up

Tool accessibility

Assembly sequence

Serviceability

The goal is not simply to create a beautiful CAD model—it must be possible to manufacture thousands of identical units reliably.

Drop resistance

Strap durability

Button durability

USB\-C connector durability

Housing strength

Repeated assembly/disassembly

Heat deformation

Lens/display mounting stability

Transportation vibration

Long\-duration wearing comfort

Engineering drawings

Materials

Plastics

Heat transfer

3D printing

A US\-based technology company is hiring engineers in Mumbai to work on the development of a next\-generation immersive entertainment headset.

Job Summary

We are looking for a responsible and technically skilled **Manufacturing Chemist** to manage and monitor day\-to\-day manufacturing activities, ensuring that products are manufactured according to approved formulations, SOPs, quality standards, and production plans. The candidate will coordinate with **Production, QA, QC, R\&D, Stores, and Maintenance** to ensure smooth and efficient manufacturing operations.

Key Roles \& Responsibilities

* **Manufacturing \& Batch Processing**
* Execute manufacturing activities as per approved **BMR, formulation, SOPs, and production schedule**.
* Ensure correct quantities of Raw Materials are dispensed and added as per the approved formula.
* Monitor manufacturing processes and ensure proper sequence of material addition, mixing, heating, cooling, and homogenization.
* **Process \& Parameter Monitoring**
* Monitor critical process parameters such as **temperature, mixing time, RPM, pH, viscosity, and batch quantity** as applicable.
* Ensure process parameters are maintained within approved limits.
* Immediately report any abnormality or process deviation to the Production/QA Manager.
* **Raw Material \& Batch Verification**
* Verify Raw Material names, codes, batch numbers, quantities, and status before starting manufacturing.
* Ensure only **approved/passed materials** are used for production.
* Coordinate with Stores and QC for material availability and status.
* **BMR \& Manufacturing Documentation**
* Complete and maintain **Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR)** accurately and on time.
* Record material usage, process parameters, equipment details, yields, and observations.
* Ensure all manufacturing documentation is completed as per GMP and SOP requirements.
* **Quality \& GMP Compliance**
* Follow **GMP, hygiene, safety, and company SOPs** during all manufacturing activities.
* Coordinate with QC/QA for in\-process testing and batch release requirements.
* Ensure manufacturing areas and equipment are maintained in proper hygienic condition.
* **Yield \& Process Control**
* Monitor batch yield and material consumption.
* Investigate abnormal yield variation, material loss, or process deviations.
* Support **RCA and CAPA** for recurring manufacturing issues.
* **Equipment \& Production Coordination**
* Ensure manufacturing equipment such as **manufacturing vessels, agitators, homogenizers, pumps, and transfer lines** are ready before batch processing.
* Coordinate with Maintenance for equipment breakdowns and preventive maintenance requirements.
* Ensure proper cleaning and line clearance before and after manufacturing activities.
* **Team Coordination \& Training**
* Guide and supervise operators/helpers involved in manufacturing activities.
* Provide training regarding manufacturing procedures, SOPs, GMP, safety, and material handling.
* Coordinate with QA, QC, R\&D, Stores, Maintenance, and PPIC for smooth batch execution.
* **Production Reporting \& Improvement**
* Prepare daily manufacturing reports and update production status to the reporting manager.
* Identify opportunities to improve **productivity, batch yield, process efficiency, and material utilization**.
* Support Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements

* **B.Sc. / M.Sc. Chemistry** or relevant qualification.
* **1–3 years of experience** in Manufacturing/Production, preferably in **Cosmetics, Personal Care, FMCG, Pharmaceutical, or Chemical manufacturing**.
* Knowledge of **GMP, BMR, SOPs, batch manufacturing, and process parameters**.
* Good understanding of cosmetic manufacturing processes such as creams, lotions, shampoos, gels, liquid products, etc.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Excel and documentation**.
* Good communication, problem\-solving, and team coordination skills.
* Willingness to work on the manufacturing shop floor and in shifts, if required.

description:
MANAGER – STARBREWS COFFEE SHOP

**Position:** Café Manager  
**Department:** Operations  
**Location:** Starbrews Coffee Shop, TCI Chowk, Rourkela  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reports To:** Owners / Management

About Starbrews

Starbrews is a modern café built around **good coffee, good food and a welcoming café experience**. We are looking for a responsible and energetic **Café Manager** who can take ownership of the day\-to\-day outlet operations and ensure smooth service.

Job Summary

The Café Manager will be responsible for the **overall operation of the outlet**, including customer service, staff management, inventory, billing, cleanliness, order management and daily reporting.

The Manager should be capable of running the café efficiently even when the owners are not present.

Key Responsibilities1\. Outlet Operations

* Take complete responsibility for the **day\-to\-day functioning of Starbrews**.
* Ensure the café opens and closes on time.
* Conduct opening and closing checks every day.
* Ensure all departments are ready before service begins.
* Monitor the café throughout the shift and resolve operational issues immediately.
* Ensure all Starbrews SOPs and operational standards are followed.

2\. Customer Experience

* Personally ensure that every customer receives **quick, polite and professional service**.
* Ensure staff attends customers promptly after they are seated.
* Monitor table service, order accuracy and serving time.
* Handle customer complaints professionally and resolve issues whenever possible.
* Take regular customer feedback and communicate important feedback to management.
* Encourage staff to suggest suitable **add\-ons and upsells** such as desserts, fries, beverages and combos.

3\. Staff Management

* Manage the daily attendance and shifts of all café employees.
* Allocate duties before every shift.
* Ensure staff are properly groomed and dressed before starting work.
* Conduct daily briefings before service.
* Monitor staff performance, discipline and behaviour.
* Ensure proper communication between the kitchen, bar and service team.
* Train new employees on Starbrews' service standards and SOPs.
* Report repeated performance or discipline issues to management.

4\. Order \& Service Management

* Monitor **dine\-in, takeaway and online orders**.
* Ensure orders are accepted only after confirming product availability.
* Coordinate between the kitchen and barista team.
* Monitor order preparation time.
* Ensure the correct items are packed and served.
* Prevent delays, missing items and incorrect orders.

5\. Inventory \& Stock Control

* Maintain daily stock levels of food, beverages, packaging and other consumables.
* Check incoming stock and verify quantities.
* Follow **FIFO (First In, First Out)**.
* Monitor wastage, spoilage and unnecessary consumption.
* Prepare purchase requirements and inform management on time.
* Ensure stock records are updated accurately.
* Conduct regular physical stock checks.

6\. Billing \& Cash Management

* Monitor all billing and payment transactions.
* Ensure every sale is properly billed through the POS system.
* Verify cash, UPI and other payment collections.
* Maintain the daily sales report.
* Report any billing discrepancy immediately.
* Ensure discounts and offers are applied only as authorized by management.

7\. Hygiene \& Café Standards

* Ensure the café, tables, service area and washroom are clean throughout the day.
* Monitor kitchen and bar hygiene.
* Ensure garbage is cleared regularly.
* Conduct regular checks for **flies, mosquitoes, spills, food contamination and cleanliness issues**.
* Ensure all staff follow proper hygiene and grooming standards.

8\. Daily Reporting

The Manager will be responsible for maintaining and submitting:

* Daily Sales Report
* Daily Expense Report
* Attendance Report
* Stock/Inventory Report
* Wastage Report
* Customer Complaint/Feedback Report
* Online Order Report
* Any operational incident report

9\. Sales \& Business Growth

* Actively look for opportunities to increase the café's average bill value.
* Train staff in **upselling and cross\-selling**.
* Monitor best\-selling and slow\-moving products.
* Suggest promotions, combos and menu improvements to management.
* Help maintain strong relationships with regular customers.

10\. Maintenance \& Problem Solving

* Immediately report equipment breakdowns or maintenance issues.
* Coordinate with vendors/service providers when authorized.
* Ensure the café never runs out of essential operational items.
* Handle day\-to\-day problems independently wherever possible.
* Escalate major financial, staff, customer or safety issues to management.

Candidate Requirements

* **2–4\+ years of experience** in café, restaurant, QSR, hospitality or retail operations.
* Previous experience as a **Café Manager / Restaurant Manager / Shift Manager / Outlet Manager** preferred.
* Strong communication and leadership skills.
* Good knowledge of customer service and outlet operations.
* Comfortable handling POS, billing and basic reports.
* Basic understanding of inventory and stock management.
* Ability to manage staff and resolve conflicts.
* Good computer and documentation skills.
* Must be **punctual, disciplined, responsible and proactive**.
* Should be comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for instructions.

Most Important Qualities

We are looking for someone who:

**Sees a problem → Takes ownership → Finds a solution → Informs management → Makes sure it doesn't happen again.**

The Manager should be able to operate Starbrews smoothly for several days **without the owners needing to supervise every small task.**

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Customer satisfaction
* Order accuracy
* Service speed
* Average bill value
* Staff discipline and attendance
* Inventory accuracy
* Food/product wastage
* Daily sales performance
* Cleanliness \& hygiene
* Customer complaints
* Compliance with Starbrews SOPs
* Overall smooth functioning of the outlet

Salary

**₹10,000 – ₹15,000 per month**, depending on experience, skills and performance.

**Location:** Starbrews Coffee Shop, TCI Chowk, Rourkela

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Reporting:** Directly to Starbrews Management

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

title: Campus Growth & Partnerships Intern
description:
Campus Growth \& Partnerships InternHackingly Innovators

**Location:** Jaipur \+ Travel  
**Duration:** 6 Months  
**Stipend:** ₹10,000–₹15,000 per month \+ performance incentives  
**Opportunity:** Pre\-placement / Full\-time opportunity after the internship

This is not a typical internship.

At **Hackingly**, we are building a large ecosystem connecting students, developers, professionals, founders, companies, colleges, universities and institutions.

As a **Campus Growth \& Partnerships Intern**, you will not simply be sending emails or making calls.

You will be **building relationships, pitching ideas, developing partnerships, identifying revenue opportunities and helping execute the programs you bring to Hackingly.**

One day, you could be speaking with a college Director. The next, you could be pitching a program to a university, coordinating an event, meeting a community leader or figuring out how an existing institutional relationship can become a larger business opportunity.

If you are someone who enjoys meeting people, dislikes repetitive work and wants to learn business by actually doing it, this internship is for you.

What will you do?

Your journey will broadly be:

**Research → Connect → Pitch → Negotiate → Close → Execute → Grow**

You will:

* Identify colleges, universities, institutes, schools and communities that could work with Hackingly.
* Reach out to decision\-makers and initiate meaningful conversations.
* Understand institutional requirements and identify potential Hackingly solutions.
* Pitch Hackingly's programs, partnerships and offerings.
* Follow up, negotiate and work towards closing paid partnerships.
* Identify opportunities for recurring or larger institutional engagements.
* Coordinate with the internal team to execute the partnerships you help close.
* Support student registrations, institutional outreach and event/program deliverables.
* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with institutional decision\-makers.
* Track conversations, opportunities and revenue pipelines.
* Explore new ways to convert institutional relationships into sustainable business opportunities.

Revenue mindset is important.

We are not looking for someone who thinks a partnership simply means signing an MoU.

We want someone who can look at an institution and think:

“What problem are they trying to solve, and how can Hackingly solve it as a meaningful business opportunity?”

A workshop could become a hackathon.

A hackathon could become a student chapter.

A student chapter could become an annual institutional partnership.

A single conversation could become a long\-term client.

You should constantly be looking for the next opportunity.

Who are we looking for?

You do not need a particular degree or years of experience.

We care much more about **personality, communication, curiosity, ownership and hunger to learn.**

You should be:

* Extremely comfortable talking to new people.
* Confident communicating with senior decision\-makers.
* Highly energetic and outgoing.
* Curious and commercially minded.
* Comfortable with rejection and persistent follow\-ups.
* Comfortable travelling and meeting people.
* Good at negotiation and persuasion.
* Comfortable working independently.
* Someone who takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.
* Interested in sales, business development, partnerships and entrepreneurship.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment where every day can look different.

Most importantly:

**You should want to build something, not just complete an internship.**

Why join Hackingly?

This will not be a conventional internship where your work is limited to lead generation.

You will learn how a real business works:

**Lead Generation**  
↓  
**Sales \& Pitching**  
↓  
**Negotiation**  
↓  
**Revenue Closure**  
↓  
**Event Execution**  
↓  
**Relationship Management**  
↓  
**Account Growth**

You will get the opportunity to interact with **Deans, Directors, Placement Heads, Founders, HR leaders, community leaders and other decision\-makers.**

You will also gain exposure to **technology, entrepreneurship, startups, campus ecosystems, events and corporate partnerships.**

What happens after six months?

We want this internship to have a clear growth path.

If you are currently in your final semester:

You can be considered for a **full\-time opportunity after completing six months**, subject to your performance and graduation requirements.

If you are already graduating / have recently graduated:

After six months, based on your performance, your **stipend can be revised**, followed by transition into a **full\-time role once you graduate**.

The objective is simple:

**Intern → Prove yourself → Grow with us → Full\-time opportunity**

Exceptional performance can accelerate this journey.

How will we measure you?

Not simply by how many calls you make.

We will look at:

* Quality of conversations
* Qualified opportunities generated
* Meetings converted
* Partnerships closed
* Revenue generated
* Institutional relationships built
* Repeat and expanded opportunities
* Execution quality
* Ownership and initiative

**Activity is good. Impact is better.**

This role is for you if...

You would rather meet interesting people than sit behind a spreadsheet all day.

You would rather pitch an idea than prepare another presentation.

You would rather work towards closing a real partnership than simply complete a target number of calls.

You would rather travel to a new city and meet a new institution than repeat the same day every day.

And if your mindset is:

“Give me a target, give me the opportunity, and I will figure out how to make it happen.”

Then we want to meet you.

Campus Growth \& Partnerships Intern

**Hackingly Innovators**

**Build relationships. Create opportunities. Drive growth.**

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time

* Submit daily and weekly recruitment performance reports to the reporting manager.
* Ensure timely follow\-up to minimize candidate dropouts and no\-shows.
* Build and maintain a strong candidate database for current and future hiring requirements.
